@@NABLA_FILE {"bytes":4955,"encoding":"utf-8","lines":118,"path":"src/nablamath/formal/search.py","payload_bytes":4955,"sha256":"d4f9b93fbfa70ec3891612f048dd1189c590b6e046d04278ef3ab45018588bb8"}
"""Deterministic Lean proof search over a closed, auditable tactic portfolio.

This is the repair-loop foundation: NablaMath generates a typed theorem from its
own AST, tries only named strategies from an allow-list, records every rejection,
and returns the first source accepted by the Lean kernel. It never evaluates
user-supplied tactic text.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable

from ..expression import Binary, Expr, Symbol
from ..symbolic.patterns import RewriteRule, instantiate_expr, pattern_variables
from .check import _verify_source
from .translate import universal_lean_source


TACTIC_PORTFOLIO: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
    ("ring", "  ring\n"),
    ("ring_nf", "  ring_nf\n"),
    ("field_ring", "  field_simp <;> ring\n"),
    ("norm_num", "  norm_num\n"),
    ("linarith", "  linarith\n"),
    ("nlinarith", "  nlinarith\n"),
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProofAttempt:
    strategy: str
    verified: bool
    detail: str
    source_hash: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProofSearchResult:
    verified: bool
    theorem_name: str
    source: str | None
    strategy: str | None
    attempts: tuple[ProofAttempt, ...]

    @property
    def content_id(self) -> str:
        payload = "|".join(f"{a.strategy}:{a.source_hash}:{int(a.verified)}" for a in self.attempts)
        return hashlib.sha256((self.theorem_name + "|" + payload).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _contains_division(expr: Expr) -> bool:
    if isinstance(expr, Binary):
        return expr.op == "/" or _contains_division(expr.left) or _contains_division(expr.right)
    return False


def candidate_strategies(lhs: Expr, rhs: Expr, nonzero: Iterable[Expr] = ()) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Return a deterministic tactic ordering based only on typed AST features."""
    has_denominator = _contains_division(lhs) or _contains_division(rhs)
    has_hypotheses = bool(tuple(nonzero))
    preferred = ["field_ring", "ring", "ring_nf"] if (has_denominator or has_hypotheses) else ["ring", "ring_nf"]
    preferred += ["norm_num", "linarith", "nlinarith"]
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(preferred))


def _source_for_strategy(lhs: Expr, rhs: Expr, *, nonzero: tuple[Expr, ...],
                         theorem_name: str, strategy: str) -> str:
    bodies = dict(TACTIC_PORTFOLIO)
    if strategy not in bodies:
        raise ValueError(f"Estratégia fora da carteira permitida: {strategy}")
    base = universal_lean_source(lhs, rhs, nonzero=nonzero, theorem_name=theorem_name)
    marker = ":= by\n"
    prefix, separator, _ = base.partition(marker)
    if not separator:
        raise RuntimeError("Gerador Lean não produziu corpo de prova reconhecível")
    body = bodies[strategy]
    if strategy == "field_ring" and nonzero:
        hypotheses = ", ".join(f"h{i}" for i in range(len(nonzero)))
        body = f"  field_simp [{hypotheses}] <;> ring\n"
    return prefix + marker + body


def search_universal_proof(lhs: Expr, rhs: Expr, project: Path, *,
                           nonzero: Iterable[Expr] = (), theorem_name: str = "nablamath_search",
                           timeout_s: int = 60) -> ProofSearchResult:
    nonzero = tuple(nonzero)
    attempts: list[ProofAttempt] = []
    for strategy in candidate_strategies(lhs, rhs, nonzero):
        source = _source_for_strategy(lhs, rhs, nonzero=nonzero, theorem_name=theorem_name, strategy=strategy)
        source_hash = hashlib.sha256(source.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        check = _verify_source(source, source_hash, project, timeout_s, f"Lean aceitou {strategy}")
        attempts.append(ProofAttempt(strategy, check.verified, check.detail, source_hash))
        if check.verified:
            return ProofSearchResult(True, theorem_name, source, strategy, tuple(attempts))
    return ProofSearchResult(False, theorem_name, None, None, tuple(attempts))


def search_rule_proof(rule: RewriteRule, project: Path, *, timeout_s: int = 60) -> ProofSearchResult:
    bindings = {name: Symbol(name) for name in pattern_variables(rule.lhs)}
    lhs = instantiate_expr(rule.lhs, bindings)
    rhs = instantiate_expr(rule.rhs, bindings)
    nonzero = tuple(bindings[c.variable] for c in rule.conditions if c.kind == "nonzero")
    safe_name = "nablamath_search_" + "".join(ch if ch.isalnum() or ch == "_" else "_" for ch in rule.name)
    return search_universal_proof(lhs, rhs, project, nonzero=nonzero, theorem_name=safe_name, timeout_s=timeout_s)


def verify_ruleset_with_lean(
    rules: Iterable[RewriteRule], project: Path, *, timeout_s: int = 60
) -> tuple[tuple[str, ProofSearchResult], ...]:
    return tuple((rule.name, search_rule_proof(rule, project, timeout_s=timeout_s)) for rule in rules)


__all__ = [
    "TACTIC_PORTFOLIO", "ProofAttempt", "ProofSearchResult", "candidate_strategies",
    "search_universal_proof", "search_rule_proof", "verify_ruleset_with_lean",
]

"""QF_LRA over rationals, with explicit hypotheses and independently replayed SAT models."""
from fractions import Fraction
from ..core.semantic_ir import fingerprint,rational
from ..expression import Binary,Number,Symbol
from .statement import FormalStatement


def solve_statement(statement,*,timeout_ms=5000):
    if type(timeout_ms) is not int or not 1<=timeout_ms<=60000:
        raise ValueError('Timeout SMT deve estar entre 1 e 60000 ms')
    try:
        import z3
    except ImportError:
        return {'status':'unavailable','backend':'z3','formal_proof':False,'statement_id':statement.content_id}
    context=z3.Context(proof=True)
    variables={name:z3.Real('nabla_'+name,ctx=context) for name in statement.variables}
    def term(expr):
        if isinstance(expr,Number):
            return z3.RealVal(str(expr.value.numerator)+'/'+str(expr.value.denominator),ctx=context),True
        if isinstance(expr,Symbol):
            return variables[expr.name],False
        left,lc=term(expr.left);right,rc=term(expr.right)
        if expr.op=='+':return left+right,lc and rc
        if expr.op=='-':return left-right,lc and rc
        if expr.op=='*' and (lc or rc):return left*right,lc and rc
        if expr.op=='/' and rc:
            constant=z3.simplify(right)
            if not z3.is_rational_value(constant) or constant.numerator_as_long()==0:
                raise ValueError('zero_or_nonrational_constant_divisor')
            return left/right,lc
        if expr.op=='**' and isinstance(expr.right,Number) and expr.right.value in (0,1):
            return (z3.RealVal(1,ctx=context),True) if expr.right.value==0 else (left,lc)
        raise ValueError('outside_QF_LRA_fragment')
    def predicate(p):
        a,_=term(p.left);b,_=term(p.right)
        return {'eq':lambda:a==b,'ne':lambda:a!=b,'le':lambda:a<=b,'lt':lambda:a<b,'ge':lambda:a>=b,'gt':lambda:a>b}[p.relation]()
    base={'backend':'z3','logic':'QF_LRA','solver_version':z3.get_version_string(),
          'statement':statement.to_data(),'statement_id':statement.content_id,'formal_proof':False,
          'trust':'Z3 result; not a Lean kernel proof','timeout_ms':timeout_ms}
    try:
        assumptions=[predicate(p) for p in statement.hypotheses]
        goal=predicate(statement.goal)
    except ValueError as exc:
        return {**base,'status':'unsupported','reason':str(exc)}
    solver=z3.SolverFor('QF_LRA',ctx=context);solver.set(timeout=timeout_ms)
    solver.add(*assumptions)
    consistent=solver.check()
    if consistent==z3.unsat:
        return {**base,'status':'inconsistent_assumptions','reason':'vacuous theorem rejected','query':solver.sexpr()}
    if consistent==z3.unknown:
        return {**base,'status':'unknown','reason':solver.reason_unknown(),'query':solver.sexpr()}
    solver.add(z3.Not(goal))
    query=solver.sexpr();status=solver.check()
    result={**base,'query':query,'query_hash':fingerprint({'query':query})}
    if status==z3.unsat:
        proof=solver.proof().sexpr()
        result.update(status='unsat',proof=proof[:1000000],proof_truncated=len(proof)>1000000,
                      interpretation='goal holds for all rationals satisfying the explicit hypotheses')
    elif status==z3.sat:
        model=solver.model();witness={}
        for name,var in variables.items():
            value=model.eval(var,model_completion=True)
            if not z3.is_rational_value(value):
                return {**result,'status':'unknown','reason':'nonrational_model'}
            witness[name]=str(Fraction(value.numerator_as_long(),value.denominator_as_long()))
        exact={n:rational(v) for n,v in witness.items()}
        if not all(p.evaluate(exact) for p in statement.hypotheses) or statement.goal.evaluate(exact):
            return {**result,'status':'replay_failed','witness':witness}
        result.update(status='counterexample',witness=witness,exact_replay=True)
    else:
        result.update(status='unknown',reason=solver.reason_unknown())
    return {**result,'receipt_id':fingerprint(result)}

"""Restricted rational propositions with partial-expression domain obligations."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from ..core.semantic_ir import SemanticExpression,canonical_json,fingerprint,rational
from ..core.obligations import domain_obligations
from ..expression import Expr,Number,parse_expr,to_data,evaluate
from ..schema.expression import from_data
from .translate import free_symbols

RELATIONS={'eq':'=','ne':'≠','le':'≤','lt':'<','ge':'≥','gt':'>'}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Predicate:
    left: Expr
    relation: str
    right: Expr

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.relation not in RELATIONS:
            raise ValueError('Relacao formal invalida')
        SemanticExpression(self.left);SemanticExpression(self.right)

    def to_data(self):
        return {'left':to_data(self.left),'relation':self.relation,'right':to_data(self.right)}

    def evaluate(self,values):
        a,b=evaluate(self.left,values),evaluate(self.right,values)
        return {'eq':a==b,'ne':a!=b,'le':a<=b,'lt':a<b,'ge':a>=b,'gt':a>b}[self.relation]

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls,data):
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'left','relation','right'}:
            raise ValueError('Predicado serializado invalido')
        return cls(from_data(data['left']),data['relation'],from_data(data['right']))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FormalStatement:
    goal: Predicate
    assumptions: tuple[Predicate,...]=()

    def __post_init__(self):
        if len(self.assumptions)>32:
            raise ValueError('Maximo 32 hipoteses')
        object.__setattr__(self,'assumptions',tuple(self.assumptions))
        if len(self.variables)>8:
            raise ValueError('Maximo oito variaveis formais')

    @classmethod
    def equality(cls,left,right,assumptions=()):
        return cls(Predicate(parse_expr(left),'eq',parse_expr(right)),tuple(assumptions))

    @property
    def variables(self):
        names=set()
        for predicate in (self.goal,*self.assumptions):
            names.update(free_symbols(predicate.left));names.update(free_symbols(predicate.right))
        return tuple(sorted(names))

    @property
    def domain(self):
        obligations=[]
        for predicate in (self.goal,*self.assumptions):
            for side in (predicate.left,predicate.right):
                obligations.extend(domain_obligations(side))
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(Predicate(o.expression,'ne',Number(rational(0))) for o in obligations))

    @property
    def hypotheses(self):
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys((*self.domain,*self.assumptions)))

    def to_data(self):
        return {'schema_version':1,'domain':'partial_rational','goal':self.goal.to_data(),
                'assumptions':[p.to_data() for p in self.assumptions],
                'domain_obligations':[p.to_data() for p in self.domain],'variables':list(self.variables)}

    @property
    def content_id(self):
        return fingerprint(self.to_data())

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls,data):
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'schema_version','domain','goal','assumptions','domain_obligations','variables'} or data['schema_version']!=1 or data['domain']!='partial_rational':
            raise ValueError('Contrato de enunciado invalido')
        result=cls(Predicate.from_data(data['goal']),tuple(Predicate.from_data(p) for p in data['assumptions']))
        if result.to_data()!=data:
            raise ValueError('Dominio ou variaveis divergentes')
        return result

"""Typed AST -> Lean translation without accepting arbitrary Lean source text."""
from __future__ import annotations
from fractions import Fraction
import re
from typing import Iterable, Mapping, TYPE_CHECKING
from ..expression import Binary, Expr, Number, Symbol
from ..symbolic.patterns import RewriteRule, instantiate_expr, pattern_variables
if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..research import ResearchResult

_LEAN_THEOREM = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_']*\Z")

def _rational(value: Fraction) -> str:
    numerator=f"({value.numerator} : ℚ)"
    return numerator if value.denominator==1 else f"({numerator} / ({value.denominator} : ℚ))"

def _lean_name(name: str) -> str:
    Symbol(name)
    return f"nabla_{name}"

def _term(expr: Expr, values: Mapping[str, Fraction] | None) -> str:
    if isinstance(expr, Number): return _rational(expr.value)
    if isinstance(expr, Symbol):
        if values is None: return _lean_name(expr.name)
        if expr.name not in values: raise ValueError(f"Sem valor para símbolo {expr.name}")
        return _rational(values[expr.name])
    left,right=_term(expr.left,values),_term(expr.right,values)
    if expr.op=="**":
        exponent=expr.right.value.numerator if isinstance(expr.right,Number) and expr.right.value.denominator==1 else None
        if exponent is None: raise ValueError("Expoente Lean precisa ser literal inteiro")
        base=f"(({left}) ^ ({abs(exponent)} : ℕ))"
        return f"({base})⁻¹" if exponent<0 else base
    return f"({left} {expr.op} {right})"

def lean_term(expr: Expr) -> str: return _term(expr,None)

def free_symbols(expr: Expr) -> tuple[str,...]:
    names=set()
    def visit(node):
        if isinstance(node,Symbol): names.add(node.name)
        elif isinstance(node,Binary): visit(node.left); visit(node.right)
    visit(expr); return tuple(sorted(names))

def lean_source(result: "ResearchResult") -> str:
    values=dict(result.values)
    return ("import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum\n\n"
            f"-- Instância racional {result.content_id}; gerada de AST restrita.\n"
            f"example : {_term(result.original,values)} = {_rational(result.value)} := by\n"
            "  norm_num\n")

def universal_lean_source(lhs: Expr, rhs: Expr, *, nonzero: Iterable[Expr]=(),
                          theorem_name: str="nablamath_generated") -> str:
    if not _LEAN_THEOREM.fullmatch(theorem_name): raise ValueError("Nome de teorema Lean inválido")
    from ..core.obligations import domain_obligations
    nonzero=tuple(dict.fromkeys((*tuple(nonzero),
        *(o.expression for side in (lhs,rhs) for o in domain_obligations(side)))))
    names=set(free_symbols(lhs))|set(free_symbols(rhs))
    for expr in nonzero: names.update(free_symbols(expr))
    declarations=" ".join(f"({_lean_name(name)} : ℚ)" for name in sorted(names))
    hypotheses=" ".join(f"(h{i} : {lean_term(expr)} ≠ 0)" for i,expr in enumerate(nonzero))
    binders=" ".join(part for part in (declarations,hypotheses) if part)
    hs=", ".join(f"h{i}" for i in range(len(nonzero)))
    tactic=f"  field_simp [{hs}] <;> ring\n" if hs else "  field_simp <;> ring\n"
    return ("import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum\n\n-- Teorema universal gerado de AST tipada pelo NablaMath.\n"
            f"theorem {theorem_name} {binders} : {lean_term(lhs)} = {lean_term(rhs)} := by\n"+tactic)

def rule_lean_source(rule: RewriteRule) -> str:
    bindings={name:Symbol(name) for name in pattern_variables(rule.lhs)}
    lhs=instantiate_expr(rule.lhs,bindings); rhs=instantiate_expr(rule.rhs,bindings)
    nonzero=tuple(bindings[c.variable] for c in rule.conditions if c.kind=="nonzero")
    safe_name="nablamath_rule_"+re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_]","_",rule.name)
    source=universal_lean_source(lhs,rhs,nonzero=nonzero,theorem_name=safe_name)
    return source.replace("-- Teorema universal gerado de AST tipada pelo NablaMath.\n",
                          f"-- Regra {rule.name}; sha256={rule.rule_hash}\n",1)

__all__=["lean_source","lean_term","free_symbols","universal_lean_source","rule_lean_source"]

    human_reviewed: bool=False

def review_translation(translation):
    from .lean_bridge import translate_statement
    expected=translate_statement(translation.statement,translation.strategy)
    errors=[]
    if translation.source!=expected.source:
        errors.append('source_does_not_match_typed_statement')
    checks=('exact_ast_regeneration','variable_bijection','all_domain_obligations_explicit',
            'only_whitelisted_tactics','no_user_lean_source')
    return StructuralReview(not errors,translation.statement.content_id,translation.source_hash,checks,tuple(errors))


def bind_translation(question, statement, *, task_id, reviewer, notes, accepted):
    """Bind a declared human review to exact question/statement/domain versions.

    This is a tamper-evident review record, not identity authentication or a
    machine proof that natural language means the supplied formal statement.
    """
    from .statement import FormalStatement
    if (not isinstance(statement, FormalStatement) or type(accepted) is not bool
            or any(not isinstance(v, str) or not v.strip() for v in (question, task_id, reviewer, notes))
            or len(question) > 100000):
        raise ValueError('Pergunta, tarefa, formalização e revisão explícita obrigatórias')
    payload = {'schema_version': 1, 'question': question, 'question_id': fingerprint(question),
               'task_id': task_id, 'statement': statement.to_data(), 'statement_id': statement.content_id,
               'reviewer': reviewer, 'notes': notes, 'accepted': accepted,
               'reviewer_identity_authenticated': False, 'semantic_equivalence_machine_proved': False}
    return {**payload, 'binding_id': fingerprint(payload)}


def verify_translation_binding(binding, *, question, statement, task_id):
    try:
        expected = bind_translation(question, statement, task_id=task_id, reviewer=binding['reviewer'],
                                    notes=binding['notes'], accepted=binding['accepted'])
        return expected == binding
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
        return False

"""Deterministic batched Monte-Carlo tree search with explicit work budgets."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math
import random
from typing import Callable, Generic, Hashable, Sequence, TypeVar

State = TypeVar("State", bound=Hashable)
Action = TypeVar("Action", bound=Hashable)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MCTSConfig:
    simulations: int = 1_024
    max_depth: int = 64
    exploration: float = math.sqrt(2.0)
    batch_size: int = 64
    seed: int = 0

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.simulations < 1 or self.max_depth < 1 or self.batch_size < 1:
            raise ValueError("Orçamentos MCTS devem ser positivos")
        if not math.isfinite(self.exploration) or self.exploration < 0:
            raise ValueError("exploration deve ser finito e não negativo")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ActionStatistic(Generic[Action]):
    action: Action
    visits: int
    mean_value: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MCTSResult(Generic[Action]):
    action: Action | None
    simulations: int
    statistics: tuple[ActionStatistic[Action], ...]


@dataclass
class _Node(Generic[State, Action]):
    state: State
    parent: _Node[State, Action] | None
    action: Action | None
    unexpanded: list[Action]
    children: dict[Action, _Node[State, Action]]
    visits: int = 0
    value_sum: float = 0.0


def batch_mcts(
    initial: State,
    *,
    actions: Callable[[State], Sequence[Action]],
    transition: Callable[[State, Action], State],
    evaluate: Callable[[Sequence[State]], Sequence[float]],
    terminal: Callable[[State], bool],
    config: MCTSConfig = MCTSConfig(),
) -> MCTSResult[Action]:
    """Search with batched leaf evaluation, suitable for a neural device backend.

    ``evaluate`` receives a batch, making accelerator utilization the caller's
    responsibility while this module retains deterministic tree accounting.
    Values are from the root player's perspective and must be finite.
    """
    rng = random.Random(config.seed)
    root_actions = list(actions(initial)) if not terminal(initial) else []
    if len(set(root_actions)) != len(root_actions):
        raise ValueError("actions retornou ações duplicadas")
    root = _Node(initial, None, None, root_actions, {})
    completed = 0
    while completed < config.simulations:
        batch_count = min(config.batch_size, config.simulations - completed)
        paths: list[list[_Node[State, Action]]] = []
        leaves: list[State] = []
        for _ in range(batch_count):
            node, path, depth = root, [root], 0
            while not terminal(node.state) and depth < config.max_depth:
                if node.unexpanded:
                    choice = rng.randrange(len(node.unexpanded))
                    action = node.unexpanded.pop(choice)
                    state = transition(node.state, action)
                    available = list(actions(state)) if not terminal(state) else []
                    if len(set(available)) != len(available):
                        raise ValueError("actions retornou ações duplicadas")
                    child = _Node(state, node, action, available, {})
                    node.children[action] = child
                    node = child
                    path.append(node)
                    break
                if not node.children:
                    break
                logarithm = math.log(max(1, node.visits))
                node = max(
                    node.children.values(),
                    key=lambda child: (
                        child.value_sum / child.visits
                        + config.exploration * math.sqrt(logarithm / child.visits)
                        if child.visits else math.inf,
                        repr(child.action),
                    ),
                )
                path.append(node)
                depth += 1
            paths.append(path)
            leaves.append(node.state)
        values = list(evaluate(leaves))
        if len(values) != len(paths):
            raise ValueError("evaluate deve devolver um valor por estado")
        for path, raw_value in zip(paths, values):
            value = float(raw_value)
            if not math.isfinite(value):
                raise ValueError("evaluate devolveu valor não finito")
            for node in path:
                node.visits += 1
                node.value_sum += value
        completed += len(paths)
    statistics = tuple(sorted(
        (ActionStatistic(action, child.visits, child.value_sum / child.visits)
         for action, child in root.children.items() if child.visits),
        key=lambda item: (-item.visits, -item.mean_value, repr(item.action)),
    ))
    return MCTSResult(statistics[0].action if statistics else None, completed, statistics)

"""F4 building block: exact modular row reduction of Macaulay matrices.

The public API accepts an optional backend implementing the same contract.  The
reference path is deterministic CPU code; an accelerator must identify itself in
the returned receipt, preventing silent CPU/GPU attribution errors.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import hashlib
import json
from typing import Protocol, Sequence


class ModularRrefBackend(Protocol):
    name: str
    accelerated: bool

    def modular_rref(self, matrix: list[list[int]], prime: int) -> tuple[list[list[int]], list[int]]: ...


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class F4ReductionResult:
    matrix: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]
    pivots: tuple[int, ...]
    prime: int
    rank: int
    backend: str
    accelerated: bool
    content_id: str


def _is_prime(value: int) -> bool:
    if value < 2:
        return False
    if value % 2 == 0:
        return value == 2
    divisor = 3
    while divisor * divisor <= value:
        if value % divisor == 0:
            return False
        divisor += 2
    return True


def _cpu_rref(matrix: list[list[int]], prime: int) -> tuple[list[list[int]], list[int]]:
    if not matrix:
        return [], []
    rows, columns = len(matrix), len(matrix[0])
    pivot_row = 0
    pivots: list[int] = []
    for column in range(columns):
        candidate = next((row for row in range(pivot_row, rows)
                          if matrix[row][column] % prime), None)
        if candidate is None:
            continue
        matrix[pivot_row], matrix[candidate] = matrix[candidate], matrix[pivot_row]
        inverse = pow(matrix[pivot_row][column] % prime, -1, prime)
        matrix[pivot_row] = [(value * inverse) % prime for value in matrix[pivot_row]]
        for row in range(rows):
            if row == pivot_row:
                continue
            factor = matrix[row][column] % prime
            if factor:
                matrix[row] = [(value - factor * pivot) % prime
                               for value, pivot in zip(matrix[row], matrix[pivot_row])]
        pivots.append(column)
        pivot_row += 1
        if pivot_row == rows:
            break
    return matrix, pivots


def modular_rref(
    rows: Sequence[Sequence[int]],
    prime: int,
    *,
    backend: ModularRrefBackend | str | None = None,
    cell_limit: int = 10_000_000,
) -> F4ReductionResult:
    """Reduce exactly over ``GF(prime)`` with independently checked device output.

    ``backend=None`` or ``"cpu"`` selects the reference. ``"cuda"`` explicitly
    requests the optional CuPy backend and fails if it is unavailable. A backend
    object remains supported for integrations; selection never implies speedup.
    """
    if type(prime) is not int or not _is_prime(prime):
        raise ValueError("O módulo deve ser primo")
    if type(cell_limit) is not int or cell_limit < 1:
        raise ValueError("cell_limit deve ser positivo")
    matrix = [list(row) for row in rows]
    columns = len(matrix[0]) if matrix else 0
    if any(len(row) != columns for row in matrix):
        raise ValueError("Matriz precisa ser retangular")
    if len(matrix) * columns > cell_limit:
        raise MemoryError("Matriz F4 excede o orçamento de células")
    if any(type(value) is not int for row in matrix for value in row):
        raise ValueError("Exact modular reduction requires integer entries")
    matrix = [[value % prime for value in row] for row in matrix]
    if isinstance(backend, str):
        if backend == "cpu":
            backend = None
        elif backend == "cuda":
            from .kernels.f4_cuda import CudaF4Backend
            backend = CudaF4Backend()
        else:
            raise ValueError("Backend must be cpu, cuda, or a ModularRrefBackend")
    if backend is None:
        reduced, pivots = _cpu_rref(matrix, prime)
        backend_name, accelerated = "cpu-reference", False
    else:
        # A third-party backend may mutate its working input. Preserve the
        # original separately so verification cannot certify a substituted matrix.
        original = [row[:] for row in matrix]
        reduced, pivots = backend.modular_rref([row[:] for row in matrix], prime)
        backend_name, accelerated = backend.name, bool(backend.accelerated)
        if len(reduced) != len(matrix) or any(len(row) != columns for row in reduced):
            raise RuntimeError("Backend devolveu matriz com shape incompatível")
        reduced = [[int(value) % prime for value in row] for row in reduced]
        # Independently verify the claimed RREF instead of trusting a device kernel.
        verified, verified_pivots = _cpu_rref(original, prime)
        if reduced != verified or list(pivots) != verified_pivots:
            raise ArithmeticError("Backend acelerado divergiu da redução modular exata")
    payload = {"matrix": reduced, "pivots": pivots, "prime": prime,
               "backend": backend_name, "accelerated": accelerated}
    content_id = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True,
                                           separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
    return F4ReductionResult(tuple(tuple(row) for row in reduced), tuple(pivots), prime,
                             len(pivots), backend_name, accelerated, content_id)


__all__ = ["F4ReductionResult", "ModularRrefBackend", "modular_rref"]

"""Optional bounded Triton child lookup, not a complete GPU e-graph.

Inputs are snapshotted once. Linear-time forest validation precedes allocation;
GPU pointer jumping is limited to an explicit supported maximum chain depth.
"""
from itertools import islice

MAX_PARENTS = 100_000
MAX_CHILDREN = 1_000_000
MAX_DEPTH = 1024
MAX_DEVICE_LOOKUPS = 10_000_000


def _snapshot(values, limit, label):
    try:
        result = tuple(islice(iter(values), limit + 1))
    except TypeError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f'{label} must be an integer iterable') from exc
    if len(result) > limit:
        raise ValueError(f'{label} budget exceeded')
    return result


def _prepare(parents, children, *, max_depth):
    if type(max_depth) is not int or not 1 <= max_depth <= MAX_DEPTH:
        raise ValueError('Supported forest depth must be in [1,1024]')
    parents = _snapshot(parents, MAX_PARENTS, 'Parent')
    children = _snapshot(children, MAX_CHILDREN, 'Child')
    count = len(parents)
    if any(type(p) is not int or not 0 <= p < count for p in parents):
        raise ValueError('Parents must index the parent array')
    if any(type(c) is not int or not 0 <= c < count for c in children):
        raise ValueError('Child index outside forest')
    roots, depths = [-1] * count, [0] * count
    # Every unresolved node enters one path once; roots memoize prior traversals.
    for start in range(count):
        if roots[start] != -1:
            continue
        cursor, path, active = start, [], set()
        while roots[cursor] == -1 and parents[cursor] != cursor:
            if cursor in active:
                raise ValueError('Cyclic parent forest')
            active.add(cursor)
            path.append(cursor)
            if len(path) > max_depth:
                raise ValueError('Forest exceeds supported chain depth')
            cursor = parents[cursor]
        if roots[cursor] == -1:
            roots[cursor] = cursor
        root, depth = roots[cursor], depths[cursor]
        for node in reversed(path):
            depth += 1
            if depth > max_depth:
                raise ValueError('Forest exceeds supported chain depth')
            roots[node], depths[node] = root, depth
    return parents, children, roots, max(depths, default=0)


def canonical_children_cpu(parents, children, *, max_depth=MAX_DEPTH):
    """Resolve an integer forest in O(parents+children), under fixed budgets."""
    _, children, roots, _ = _prepare(parents, children, max_depth=max_depth)
    return [roots[child] for child in children]


def canonical_children_triton(parents, children, *, max_depth=MAX_DEPTH):
    """Resolve one immutable validated snapshot on CUDA; no implicit fallback."""
    parents, children, roots, depth = _prepare(parents, children, max_depth=max_depth)
    if len(children) * max(1, depth) > MAX_DEVICE_LOOKUPS:
        raise ValueError('Device pointer lookup work budget exceeded')
    expected = [roots[child] for child in children]
    try:
        import torch
        import triton
        import triton.language as tl
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError('Triton and CUDA-enabled PyTorch are required') from exc
    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
        raise RuntimeError('CUDA device unavailable')
    if not children:
        return []

    @triton.jit
    def lookup(P, C, O, N: tl.constexpr, DEPTH: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
        index = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
        mask = index < N
        child = tl.load(C + index, mask=mask, other=0)
        for _ in range(DEPTH):
            child = tl.load(P + child, mask=mask, other=0)
        tl.store(O + index, child, mask=mask)

    parent_tensor = torch.tensor(parents, dtype=torch.int64, device='cuda')
    child_tensor = torch.tensor(children, dtype=torch.int64, device='cuda')
    result = torch.empty_like(child_tensor)
    lookup[(triton.cdiv(len(children), 256),)](
        parent_tensor, child_tensor, result, len(children), depth, 256)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    actual = result.cpu().tolist()
    if actual != expected:
        raise ArithmeticError('Device canonicalization differs from CPU oracle')
    return actual

"""Exact modular elimination on CUDA via an optional CuPy RawKernel.

Pivot selection synchronizes with the host; row arithmetic executes on the device.
This favors auditability over speed. No acceleration claim follows from selection.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

_KERNEL = r'''
extern "C" __global__ void eliminate(long long* a, const long long* pivot,
    int rows, int cols, int prow, int pcol, long long prime) {
    int row = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (row >= rows || row == prow) return;
    long long factor = a[row * cols + pcol];
    for (int col = 0; col < cols; ++col) {
        long long value = (a[row * cols + col] - factor * pivot[col]) % prime;
        a[row * cols + col] = value < 0 ? value + prime : value;
    }
}
'''


class CudaUnavailable(RuntimeError):
    """Requested device execution cannot be provided; no silent fallback."""


class CudaF4Backend:
    name = "cupy-rawkernel-cuda-f4-v1"
    accelerated = True

    def __init__(self):
        try:
            import cupy as cp
            if cp.cuda.runtime.getDeviceCount() < 1:
                raise CudaUnavailable("No CUDA device")
            self.cp = cp
            self.kernel = cp.RawKernel(_KERNEL, "eliminate")
        except (ImportError, RuntimeError) as exc:
            raise CudaUnavailable("CuPy and a working CUDA device are required") from exc

    def modular_rref(self, matrix, prime):
        # Restrict the arithmetic contract before allocating a device buffer.
        from ..cuda_f4_reduction import _is_prime
        if type(prime) is not int or not 2 <= prime <= 32749 or not _is_prime(prime):
            raise ValueError("CUDA F4 requires a prime in [2,32749]")
        if not matrix:
            return [], []
        columns = len(matrix[0])
        if any(len(row) != columns for row in matrix):
            raise ValueError("Rectangular matrix required")
        if len(matrix) * columns > 10_000_000:
            raise MemoryError("CUDA F4 cell budget exceeded")
        if any(type(value) is not int for row in matrix for value in row):
            raise ValueError("Integer entries required")
        if not columns:
            return [[] for _ in matrix], []
        cp = self.cp
        data = cp.asarray([[v % prime for v in row] for row in matrix], dtype=cp.int64)
        pivots, prow = [], 0
        for column in range(columns):
            candidates = cp.asnumpy(cp.flatnonzero(data[prow:, column]))
            if not len(candidates):
                continue
            chosen = prow + int(candidates[0])
            if chosen != prow:
                temporary = data[prow].copy()
                data[prow] = data[chosen]
                data[chosen] = temporary
            inverse = pow(int(data[prow, column].item()), -1, prime)
            data[prow] = (data[prow] * inverse) % prime
            pivot = data[prow].copy()
            self.kernel(((len(matrix) + 127) // 128,), (128,),
                        (data, pivot, cp.int32(len(matrix)), cp.int32(columns),
                         cp.int32(prow), cp.int32(column), cp.int64(prime)))
            pivots.append(column)
            prow += 1
            if prow == len(matrix):
                break
        cp.cuda.get_current_stream().synchronize()
        return cp.asnumpy(data).tolist(), pivots

"""Small auditable INT8 linear policy for ranking symbolic actions."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math
from typing import Sequence


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class QuantizedLinearGuide:
    """Symmetric per-tensor INT8 policy with deterministic integer accumulation."""

    actions: tuple[str, ...]
    weights: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]
    biases: tuple[int, ...]
    weight_scale: float
    feature_scale: float

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not self.actions or len(set(self.actions)) != len(self.actions):
            raise ValueError("Ações devem ser únicas e não vazias")
        if len(self.weights) != len(self.actions) or len(self.biases) != len(self.actions):
            raise ValueError("Uma linha de pesos e bias é exigida por ação")
        width = len(self.weights[0]) if self.weights else 0
        if width < 1 or any(len(row) != width for row in self.weights):
            raise ValueError("Matriz de pesos deve ser retangular e não vazia")
        if any(not -127 <= value <= 127 for row in self.weights for value in row):
            raise ValueError("Pesos precisam caber em INT8 simétrico")
        if not all(math.isfinite(scale) and scale > 0
                   for scale in (self.weight_scale, self.feature_scale)):
            raise ValueError("Escalas devem ser finitas e positivas")

    @property
    def feature_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.weights[0])

    @classmethod
    def quantize(cls, actions: Sequence[str], weights: Sequence[Sequence[float]],
                 biases: Sequence[float] | None = None, *, feature_scale: float = 1 / 127) -> QuantizedLinearGuide:
        rows = [list(map(float, row)) for row in weights]
        if not rows or any(len(row) != len(rows[0]) for row in rows):
            raise ValueError("Matriz de pesos inválida")
        maximum = max((abs(value) for row in rows for value in row), default=0.0)
        weight_scale = maximum / 127 if maximum else 1.0
        quantized = tuple(tuple(max(-127, min(127, round(value / weight_scale)))
                                 for value in row) for row in rows)
        raw_biases = list(biases or [0.0] * len(rows))
        accumulator_scale = weight_scale * feature_scale
        quantized_biases = tuple(round(value / accumulator_scale) for value in raw_biases)
        return cls(tuple(actions), quantized, quantized_biases, weight_scale, feature_scale)

    def logits(self, features: Sequence[float]) -> tuple[float, ...]:
        if len(features) != self.feature_count:
            raise ValueError("Número incorreto de features")
        if any(not math.isfinite(float(value)) for value in features):
            raise ValueError("Features devem ser finitas")
        quantized_features = tuple(max(-127, min(127, round(float(value) / self.feature_scale)))
                                   for value in features)
        scale = self.weight_scale * self.feature_scale
        return tuple((sum(weight * feature for weight, feature in zip(row, quantized_features)) + bias)
                     * scale for row, bias in zip(self.weights, self.biases))

    def rank(self, features: Sequence[float]) -> tuple[tuple[str, float], ...]:
        return tuple(sorted(zip(self.actions, self.logits(features)),
                            key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0])))


__all__ = ["QuantizedLinearGuide"]

def hardware_profile():
    result = {"schema_version": 1, "system": platform.system(),
              "machine": platform.machine(), "processor": platform.processor(),
              "python": platform.python_version(), "logical_cpus": os.cpu_count(),
              "cuda_devices": [], "gpu_probe_error": None}
    executable = shutil.which("nvidia-smi")
    if executable is None:
        result["gpu_probe_error"] = "nvidia-smi unavailable"
        return result
    try:
        output = subprocess.run(
            [executable, "--query-gpu=uuid,name,driver_version,memory.total,power.draw",
             "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"], capture_output=True, text=True,
            timeout=5, check=True)
        for row in csv.reader(io.StringIO(output.stdout)):
            if len(row) != 5:
                raise ValueError("Unexpected GPU telemetry columns")
            uuid, name, driver, memory, watts = [s.strip() for s in row]
            def sensor(value):
                try:
                    number = float(value)
                    return number if math.isfinite(number) and number >= 0 else None
                except ValueError:
                    return None
            result["cuda_devices"].append({"uuid": uuid, "name": name,
                "driver": driver, "memory_total_mib": sensor(memory),
                "power_snapshot_watts": sensor(watts)})
    except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        result["gpu_probe_error"] = type(exc).__name__
    return result

class ProfileReceipt:
    backend: str
    repetitions: int
    seconds: tuple[float, ...]
    hardware: dict
    energy_joules: None = None
    peak_vram_bytes: None = None
    limitation: str = "No integrated energy or peak VRAM sensor; wall time includes synchronization"

    def to_data(self):
        return asdict(self)


def profile_operation(operation, *, backend, repetitions=5, synchronize=None):
    if not isinstance(backend, str) or not backend.strip():
        raise ValueError("Backend identity required")
    if type(repetitions) is not int or not 1 <= repetitions <= 100:
        raise ValueError("Repetitions must be in [1,100]")
    times = []
    for _ in range(repetitions):
        if synchronize:
            synchronize()
        start = time.perf_counter()
        operation()
        if synchronize:
            synchronize()
        times.append(time.perf_counter() - start)
    return ProfileReceipt(backend, repetitions, tuple(times), hardware_profile())

"""Packed integer representation and batched congruence operations for e-graphs."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Iterable


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PackedENode:
    opcode: int
    left: int
    right: int


class TensorEGraph:
    """Array-oriented union-find suitable for transfer to device backends.

    This class handles packed topology, not symbolic rule semantics.  It is a safe
    staging representation for accelerator kernels and provides a CPU oracle.
    """

    def __init__(self, class_count: int, *, class_limit: int = 10_000_000) -> None:
        if type(class_count) is not int or not 0 <= class_count <= class_limit:
            raise ValueError("class_count fora do orçamento")
        self.parent = list(range(class_count))
        self.rank = [0] * class_count
        self.nodes: list[PackedENode] = []
        self._node_keys: set[PackedENode] = set()

    def find(self, item: int) -> int:
        if type(item) is not int or not 0 <= item < len(self.parent):
            raise IndexError("e-class inexistente")
        root = item
        while self.parent[root] != root:
            root = self.parent[root]
        while item != root:
            parent, self.parent[item] = self.parent[item], root
            item = parent
        return root

    def union(self, first: int, second: int) -> bool:
        first, second = self.find(first), self.find(second)
        if first == second:
            return False
        if self.rank[first] < self.rank[second] or (
            self.rank[first] == self.rank[second] and first > second
        ):
            first, second = second, first
        self.parent[second] = first
        if self.rank[first] == self.rank[second]:
            self.rank[first] += 1
        return True

    def union_batch(self, pairs: Iterable[tuple[int, int]]) -> int:
        changed = 0
        for first, second in pairs:
            changed += self.union(first, second)
        return changed

    def add_nodes(self, nodes: Iterable[PackedENode], *, node_limit: int = 10_000_000) -> int:
        added = 0
        for node in nodes:
            if node.opcode < 0:
                raise ValueError("Opcode precisa ser não negativo")
            canonical = PackedENode(node.opcode, self.find(node.left), self.find(node.right))
            if canonical in self._node_keys:
                continue
            if len(self.nodes) >= node_limit:
                raise MemoryError("Tensor e-graph excedeu o orçamento de nós")
            self.nodes.append(canonical)
            self._node_keys.add(canonical)
            added += 1
        return added

    def rebuild_congruence(self) -> int:
        """Merge owners of equal nodes; node index is also the owner when possible."""
        owners: dict[PackedENode, int] = {}
        merges = 0
        rebuilt: list[PackedENode] = []
        for index, node in enumerate(self.nodes):
            canonical = PackedENode(node.opcode, self.find(node.left), self.find(node.right))
            owner = min(index, len(self.parent) - 1) if self.parent else 0
            if canonical in owners and self.parent:
                merges += self.union(owner, owners[canonical])
            else:
                owners[canonical] = owner
            rebuilt.append(canonical)
        self.nodes = rebuilt
        self._node_keys = set(rebuilt)
        return merges

    def components(self) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]:
        groups: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
        for item in range(len(self.parent)):
            groups.setdefault(self.find(item), []).append(item)
        return tuple(tuple(groups[root]) for root in sorted(groups))


__all__ = ["PackedENode", "TensorEGraph"]

"""Budgeted device-buffer residency without pretending a CPU is a GPU."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import hashlib
from typing import Protocol


class BufferBackend(Protocol):
    name: str
    accelerated: bool

    def allocate(self, size: int) -> object: ...
    def write(self, buffer: object, data: bytes) -> None: ...
    def read(self, buffer: object, size: int) -> bytes: ...
    def release(self, buffer: object) -> None: ...


class CpuBufferBackend:
    """Reference backend used for tests and machines without an accelerator."""

    name = "cpu-bytearray"
    accelerated = False

    def allocate(self, size: int) -> bytearray:
        return bytearray(size)

    def write(self, buffer: object, data: bytes) -> None:
        if not isinstance(buffer, bytearray):
            raise TypeError("CpuBufferBackend recebeu buffer incompatível")
        buffer[:len(data)] = data

    def read(self, buffer: object, size: int) -> bytes:
        if not isinstance(buffer, bytearray):
            raise TypeError("CpuBufferBackend recebeu buffer incompatível")
        return bytes(buffer[:size])

    def release(self, buffer: object) -> None:
        if isinstance(buffer, bytearray):
            buffer.clear()


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BufferHandle:
    identifier: str
    size_bytes: int
    sha256: str
    backend: str
    accelerated: bool


class BufferManager:
    """Own device allocations under a hard byte budget.

    Deduplication is content-addressed.  Handles become invalid immediately after
    release; callers never receive the backend's mutable allocation object.
    """

    def __init__(self, capacity_bytes: int, backend: BufferBackend | None = None) -> None:
        if type(capacity_bytes) is not int or capacity_bytes < 1:
            raise ValueError("capacity_bytes deve ser inteiro positivo")
        self.capacity_bytes = capacity_bytes
        self.backend = backend or CpuBufferBackend()
        self._allocations: dict[str, tuple[object, BufferHandle, int]] = {}
        self._used_bytes = 0

    @property
    def used_bytes(self) -> int:
        return self._used_bytes

    @property
    def available_bytes(self) -> int:
        return self.capacity_bytes - self._used_bytes

    def put(self, data: bytes) -> BufferHandle:
        if not isinstance(data, bytes):
            raise TypeError("BufferManager aceita bytes imutáveis")
        digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        if digest in self._allocations:
            allocation, handle, references = self._allocations[digest]
            self._allocations[digest] = (allocation, handle, references + 1)
            return handle
        if len(data) > self.available_bytes:
            raise MemoryError("Orçamento do dispositivo excedido")
        allocation = self.backend.allocate(len(data))
        try:
            self.backend.write(allocation, data)
        except BaseException:
            self.backend.release(allocation)
            raise
        handle = BufferHandle(digest, len(data), digest, self.backend.name,
                              bool(self.backend.accelerated))
        self._allocations[digest] = (allocation, handle, 1)
        self._used_bytes += len(data)
        return handle

    def get(self, handle: BufferHandle) -> bytes:
        record = self._allocations.get(handle.identifier)
        if record is None or record[1] != handle:
            raise KeyError("Handle de buffer ausente ou obsoleto")
        data = self.backend.read(record[0], handle.size_bytes)
        if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != handle.sha256:
            raise RuntimeError("Corrupção detectada no buffer residente")
        return data

    def release(self, handle: BufferHandle) -> None:
        record = self._allocations.get(handle.identifier)
        if record is None or record[1] != handle:
            raise KeyError("Handle de buffer ausente ou obsoleto")
        allocation, _, references = record
        if references > 1:
            self._allocations[handle.identifier] = (allocation, handle, references - 1)
            return
        self.backend.release(allocation)
        del self._allocations[handle.identifier]
        self._used_bytes -= handle.size_bytes

    def close(self) -> None:
        for allocation, _, _ in self._allocations.values():
            self.backend.release(allocation)
        self._allocations.clear()
        self._used_bytes = 0

    def __enter__(self) -> BufferManager:
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *ignored: object) -> None:
        self.close()


__all__ = ["BufferBackend", "BufferHandle", "BufferManager", "CpuBufferBackend"]

"""Editable scene bundles with hashes, exact constraint checks and model replay."""
from pathlib import Path

def replay_model(scene):
    model=json.loads(scene.model_json);kind=model.get('kind')
    if kind=='inverse_geometry':
        from ..forge.constructors.geometry import construct
        expected=construct(model['seed'],model['size'],model['construction'])
    elif kind=='function':
        from .sampling import function_scene
        expected=function_scene(model['source'],xmin=model['xmin'],xmax=model['xmax'],samples=model['samples'])
    elif kind=='adaptive_function':
        from .sampling import adaptive_function_scene
        expected=adaptive_function_scene(model['source'],xmin=model['xmin'],xmax=model['xmax'],
                                        tolerance=model['tolerance'],max_segments=model['max_segments'])
    elif kind=='vector_field':
        from .sampling import vector_field_scene
        expected=vector_field_scene(model['dx'],model['dy'],bounds=tuple(model['bounds']),grid=model['grid'])
    elif kind=='phase_portrait':
        from .sampling import phase_portrait_scene
        expected=phase_portrait_scene(model['dx'],model['dy'],initials=tuple(tuple(v) for v in model['initials']),
             duration=model['duration'],steps=model['steps'],bounds=tuple(model['bounds']),grid=model['grid'])
    elif not model:
        return {'status':'not_applicable','valid':True,'scope':'user_authored_scene; constraints checked separately'}
    else:
        return {'status':'unknown_model','valid':False}
    return {'status':'replayed','valid':scene.to_data()==expected.to_data(),'scope':'reconstruction from declared model, not empirical validation'}


def export_scene(scene,destination,*,width=800,height=600):
    geometry=verify_geometry(scene);model=replay_model(scene)
    if not geometry.valid or not model['valid']:
        raise ValueError('Cena falhou em restricoes ou reexecucao do modelo')
    target=Path(destination).absolute()
    if target.exists():raise FileExistsError(target)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    stage=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.nabla-diagram-',dir=target.parent))
    try:
        (stage/'scene.json').write_text(canonical_json(scene.to_data())+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        (stage/'scene.svg').write_text(render_svg(scene,width,height),encoding='utf-8')
        (stage/'scene.png').write_bytes(render_png(scene,width,height))
        report={'schema_version':1,'scene_id':scene.content_id,'geometry':geometry.to_data(),'model':model,
                'width':width,'height':height,'formal_proof':False}
        (stage/'verification.json').write_text(canonical_json(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        manifest={'schema_version':1,'kind':'scientific_scene','files':{p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(stage.iterdir())}}
        (stage/'manifest.json').write_text(canonical_json(manifest)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        if not verify_scene_bundle(stage):raise ArithmeticError('Bundle visual falhou na verificacao')
        if target.exists():raise FileExistsError(target)
        stage.rename(target)
        return report
    finally:
        if stage.exists():shutil.rmtree(stage)


def verify_scene_bundle(directory):
    try:
        root=Path(directory)
        paths=('scene.json','scene.svg','scene.png','verification.json','manifest.json')
        if {p.name for p in root.iterdir()}!=set(paths):return False
        if any((root/name).is_symlink() or (root/name).stat().st_size>16*1024*1024 for name in paths):return False
        manifest=json.loads((root/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if manifest['kind']!='scientific_scene' or manifest['schema_version']!=1 or set(manifest['files'])!=set(paths)-{'manifest.json'}:return False
        if any(hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=digest for name,digest in manifest['files'].items()):return False
        scene=GeometryScene.from_data(json.loads((root/'scene.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
        report=json.loads((root/'verification.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        geometry=verify_geometry(scene);model=replay_model(scene)
        if not geometry.valid or not model['valid']:return False
        if report!={'schema_version':1,'scene_id':scene.content_id,'geometry':geometry.to_data(),'model':model,
                   'width':report['width'],'height':report['height'],'formal_proof':False}:return False
        return ((root/'scene.svg').read_text(encoding='utf-8')==render_svg(scene,report['width'],report['height'])
                and (root/'scene.png').read_bytes()==render_png(scene,report['width'],report['height']))
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,ArithmeticError):
        return False

"""Exact world-to-screen transforms; scientific scenes preserve aspect by default."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from fractions import Fraction
from ..core.semantic_ir import rational


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CoordinateSystem:
    xmin: Fraction
    xmax: Fraction
    ymin: Fraction
    ymax: Fraction
    x_unit: str='1'
    y_unit: str='1'
    preserve_aspect: bool=True

    def __post_init__(self):
        for name in ('xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax'):
            object.__setattr__(self,name,rational(getattr(self,name)))
        if type(self.preserve_aspect) is not bool:
            raise ValueError('preserve_aspect deve ser booleano')
        if self.xmin>=self.xmax or self.ymin>=self.ymax or len(self.x_unit)>24 or len(self.y_unit)>24:
            raise ValueError('Limites ou unidades de coordenadas invalidos')

    def transform(self,width=800,height=600,padding=48):
        if type(width) is not int or type(height) is not int or not 128<=width<=2048 or not 128<=height<=2048:
            raise ValueError('Imagem cientifica deve ter 128..2048 pixels por eixo')
        if type(padding) is not int or not 16<=padding<min(width,height)/2:
            raise ValueError('Margem invalida')
        sx=Fraction(width-2*padding)/(self.xmax-self.xmin)
        sy=Fraction(height-2*padding)/(self.ymax-self.ymin)
        if self.preserve_aspect:
            sx=sy=min(sx,sy)
        left=(width-sx*(self.xmax-self.xmin))/2
        top=(height-sy*(self.ymax-self.ymin))/2
        return ScreenTransform(self,width,height,sx,sy,left,top)

    def to_data(self):
        return {'xmin':str(self.xmin),'xmax':str(self.xmax),'ymin':str(self.ymin),'ymax':str(self.ymax),
                'x_unit':self.x_unit,'y_unit':self.y_unit,'preserve_aspect':self.preserve_aspect}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ScreenTransform:
    system: CoordinateSystem
    width: int
    height: int
    sx: Fraction
    sy: Fraction
    left: Fraction
    top: Fraction

    def pixel(self,x,y):
        return (round(self.left+(rational(x)-self.system.xmin)*self.sx),
                round(self.top+(self.system.ymax-rational(y))*self.sy))

    def world(self,x,y):
        return self.system.xmin+(Fraction(x)-self.left)/self.sx,self.system.ymax-(Fraction(y)-self.top)/self.sy

    def inside(self,x,y):
        return self.system.xmin<=x<=self.system.xmax and self.system.ymin<=y<=self.system.ymax

"""Typed coordinate relations; constraints remain data independently of rendering."""
from dataclasses import dataclass

ARITY={'coincident':2,'distinct':2,'collinear':3,'noncollinear':3,'parallel':4,'perpendicular':4,
       'equal_distance':4,'distance_squared':2,'on_circle':2,'midpoint':3,'orientation':3}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GeometryConstraint:
    kind: str
    points: tuple[str,...]
    value: object=None

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.kind not in ARITY or len(self.points)!=ARITY[self.kind]:
            raise ValueError('Relacao geometrica ou aridade invalida')
        object.__setattr__(self,'points',tuple(self.points))
        if self.kind in {'distance_squared','on_circle','orientation'}:
            if self.value is None:
                raise ValueError('Relacao requer valor')
            object.__setattr__(self,'value',rational(self.value))
            if self.kind!='orientation' and self.value<0:
                raise ValueError('Distancia quadrada nao pode ser negativa')
            if self.kind=='orientation' and self.value not in (-1,0,1):
                raise ValueError('Orientacao deve ser -1, 0 ou 1')
        elif self.value is not None:
            raise ValueError('Relacao nao admite valor adicional')

    def to_data(self):
        return {'kind':self.kind,'points':list(self.points),'value':None if self.value is None else str(self.value)}

"""Deterministic shared geometry for SVG/PNG, clipping and collision-aware point labels."""
from fractions import Fraction
import math


def clip_line(a,b,box):
    xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax=box
    dx,dy=b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1];lo,hi=Fraction(),Fraction(1)
    for p,q in ((-dx,a[0]-xmin),(dx,xmax-a[0]),(-dy,a[1]-ymin),(dy,ymax-a[1])):
        if p==0:
            if q<0:return None
            continue
        ratio=Fraction(q,p)
        if p<0:lo=max(lo,ratio)
        else:hi=min(hi,ratio)
        if lo>hi:return None
    return ((round(a[0]+lo*dx),round(a[1]+lo*dy)),(round(a[0]+hi*dx),round(a[1]+hi*dy)))


def place_labels(points,width,height):
    occupied=[];placements=[];warnings=[]
    for name,x,y in points:
        w,h=7*len(name)+6,16
        candidates=((x+8,y-18),(x+8,y+6),(x-w-8,y-18),(x-w-8,y+6),(x-w//2,y-24),(x-w//2,y+10))
        selected=None
        for px,py in candidates:
            rectangle=(px,py,px+w,py+h)
            if px<2 or py<24 or px+w>width-2 or py+h>height-24:continue
            if all(rectangle[2]<=old[0] or rectangle[0]>=old[2] or rectangle[3]<=old[1] or rectangle[1]>=old[3] for old in occupied):
                selected=rectangle;break
        if selected is None:
            selected=(max(2,min(x+8,width-w-2)),max(24,min(y-18,height-h-24)),0,0)
            selected=(selected[0],selected[1],selected[0]+w,selected[1]+h)
            warnings.append('label_collision_or_clipping:'+name)
        occupied.append(selected);placements.append((name,selected[0],selected[1]))
    return placements,warnings


def build_primitives(scene,width=800,height=600):
    transform=scene.coordinates.transform(width,height)
    c=scene.coordinates
    top_left=transform.pixel(c.xmin,c.ymax);bottom_right=transform.pixel(c.xmax,c.ymin)
    box=(*top_left,*bottom_right)
    primitives=[];warnings=[]
    def line(a,b,color='#2456a6',thickness=2):
        clipped=clip_line(a,b,box)
        if clipped:primitives.append({'kind':'line','points':clipped,'color':color,'width':thickness})
    for index in range(6):
        x=c.xmin+(c.xmax-c.xmin)*index/5;y=c.ymin+(c.ymax-c.ymin)*index/5
        line(transform.pixel(x,c.ymin),transform.pixel(x,c.ymax),'#e5e7eb',1)
        line(transform.pixel(c.xmin,y),transform.pixel(c.xmax,y),'#e5e7eb',1)
    if c.xmin<=0<=c.xmax:line(transform.pixel(0,c.ymin),transform.pixel(0,c.ymax),'#777777',1)
    if c.ymin<=0<=c.ymax:line(transform.pixel(c.xmin,0),transform.pixel(c.xmax,0),'#777777',1)
    points={p.name:(p.x,p.y) for p in scene.points}
    for segment in scene.segments:
        line(transform.pixel(*points[segment.start]),transform.pixel(*points[segment.end]))
    for circle in scene.circles:
        x,y=points[circle.center];radius=math.sqrt(float(circle.radius_squared))
        samples=[transform.pixel(x+Fraction(str(radius*math.cos(i*math.tau/128))),y+Fraction(str(radius*math.sin(i*math.tau/128)))) for i in range(129)]
        for a,b in zip(samples,samples[1:]):line(a,b,'#168568',2)
    for curve in scene.curves:
        pixels=[transform.pixel(x,y) for x,y in curve.coordinates]
        color='#cc641f' if curve.role=='numerical_trajectory' else '#2456a6'
        for a,b in zip(pixels,pixels[1:]):line(a,b,color,2)
        if len(pixels)==1 and transform.inside(*curve.coordinates[0]):
            primitives.append({'kind':'point','point':pixels[0],'color':color})
    for arrow in scene.arrows:
        start,end=transform.pixel(*arrow.start),transform.pixel(*arrow.end)
        line(start,end,'#8798ad',1)
        dx,dy=end[0]-start[0],end[1]-start[1];length=math.hypot(dx,dy)
        if length>0:
            ux,uy=dx/length,dy/length
            for sign in (-1,1):
                tip=(round(end[0]-6*ux+sign*3*uy),round(end[1]-6*uy-sign*3*ux))
                line(tip,end,'#8798ad',1)
    label_points=[]
    for point in scene.points:
        if not transform.inside(point.x,point.y):
            warnings.append('point_outside_viewport:'+point.name);continue
        pixel=transform.pixel(point.x,point.y)
        primitives.append({'kind':'point','point':pixel,'color':'#17365f'})
        label_points.append((point.name,*pixel))
    labels,label_warnings=place_labels(label_points,width,height);warnings.extend(label_warnings)
    for name,x,y in labels:primitives.append({'kind':'text','position':(x,y),'text':name,'color':'#17365f'})
    primitives.extend([
        {'kind':'text','position':(12,8),'text':scene.title,'color':'#17365f'},
        {'kind':'text','position':(12,height-34),'text':f'x=[{c.xmin},{c.xmax}] {c.x_unit}; y=[{c.ymin},{c.ymax}] {c.y_unit}','color':'#555555'},
        {'kind':'text','position':(12,height-18),'text':'exact coordinate metadata; curves/trajectories are samples','color':'#555555'}])
    return primitives,{'warnings':warnings,'aspect_preserved':c.preserve_aspect,'circle_rendering':'128-segment approximation',
                       'viewport':list(box),'scene_id':scene.content_id}

"""Dependency-free deterministic RGB PNG, using the same scene transform as SVG."""
import struct
import json
import zlib
from .scene_graph import Scene


def render_png(scene: Scene, width: int = 640, height: int = 400) -> bytes:
    from .scene_graph import GeometryScene
    if isinstance(scene, GeometryScene):
        from .rendering import render_rich_png
        return render_rich_png(scene, width, height)
    points = scene.pixels(width, height)
    pixels = bytearray(b'\xff' * (width * height * 3))

    def dot(x: int, y: int) -> None:
        if 0 <= x < width and 0 <= y < height:
            offset = 3 * (y * width + x)
            pixels[offset:offset + 3] = bytes((36, 86, 166))

    def line(a: tuple[int, int], b: tuple[int, int]) -> None:
        x, y = a
        tx, ty = b
        dx, dy = abs(tx - x), -abs(ty - y)
        sx, sy = (1 if x < tx else -1), (1 if y < ty else -1)
        error = dx + dy
        while True:
            dot(x, y)
            if (x, y) == (tx, ty):
                break
            twice = 2 * error
            if twice >= dy:
                error += dy
                x += sx
            if twice <= dx:
                error += dx
                y += sy

    if scene.connected:
        for a, b in zip(points, points[1:]):
            line(a, b)
    for x, y in points:
        for dx in range(-2, 3):
            for dy in range(-2, 3):
                dot(x + dx, y + dy)

    def chunk(kind: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
        return struct.pack('>I', len(data)) + kind + data + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(kind + data))

    scanlines = b''.join(b'\0' + pixels[y * width * 3:(y + 1) * width * 3] for y in range(height))
    metadata = ("Description\0" + json.dumps(scene.to_data(), sort_keys=True)).encode('ascii')
    return (b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' + chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', width, height, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
            + chunk(b'tEXt', metadata) + chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(scanlines, 9)) + chunk(b'IEND', b''))

def render_rich_svg(scene,width=800,height=600):
    primitives,layout=build_primitives(scene,width,height)
    lines=[f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img">',
           f'<title>{escape(scene.title)}</title>',
           '<metadata>'+escape(canonical_json({'scene':scene.to_data(),'layout':layout}))+'</metadata>',
           '<rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="white"/>']
    for p in primitives:
        if p['kind']=='line':
            (x1,y1),(x2,y2)=p['points']
            lines.append(f'<line x1="{x1}" y1="{y1}" x2="{x2}" y2="{y2}" stroke="{p["color"]}" stroke-width="{p["width"]}"/>')
        elif p['kind']=='point':
            x,y=p['point'];lines.append(f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="3" fill="{p["color"]}"/>')
        else:
            x,y=p['position'];lines.append(f'<text x="{x}" y="{y+12}" fill="{p["color"]}" font-family="monospace" font-size="12">{escape(p["text"])}</text>')
    return '\n'.join(lines+['</svg>',''])


def render_rich_png(scene,width=800,height=600):
    try:
        from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont,PngImagePlugin
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError('Raster geometrico requer o extra graphics (Pillow)') from exc
    primitives,layout=build_primitives(scene,width,height)
    image=Image.new('RGB',(width,height),'white');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(image);font=ImageFont.load_default(size=12)
    for p in primitives:
        if p['kind']=='line':draw.line(p['points'],fill=p['color'],width=p['width'])
        elif p['kind']=='point':
            x,y=p['point'];draw.ellipse((x-3,y-3,x+3,y+3),fill=p['color'])
        else:draw.text(p['position'],p['text'],fill=p['color'],font=font)
    metadata=PngImagePlugin.PngInfo()
    metadata.add_itxt('NablaScene',canonical_json(scene.to_data()))
    metadata.add_itxt('NablaLayout',canonical_json(layout))
    output=BytesIO();image.save(output,format='PNG',pnginfo=metadata,optimize=False,compress_level=9)

"""Model-linked rational curve/field samples and explicitly numerical phase trajectories."""
from fractions import Fraction
import json
from ..core.semantic_ir import SemanticExpression,canonical_json,rational
from ..core.precision import RationalInterval
from ..expression import Binary,Number,Symbol,evaluate,parse_expr,DomainError,to_data
from ..math.equations.ode import integrate
from .scene_graph import GeometryScene,Polyline,Arrow

def _interval(expr,lower,upper):
    if isinstance(expr,Number):return RationalInterval(expr.value,expr.value)
    if isinstance(expr,Symbol):return RationalInterval(lower,upper)
    left,right=_interval(expr.left,lower,upper),_interval(expr.right,lower,upper)
    if expr.op=='+':return left+right
    if expr.op=='-':return left+RationalInterval(-right.upper,-right.lower)
    if expr.op=='*':return left*right
    if expr.op=='/':return left/right
    exponent=expr.right.value.numerator
    if exponent<0:return RationalInterval(1,1)/_interval(Binary('**',expr.left,Number(Fraction(-exponent))),lower,upper)
    if exponent==0:return RationalInterval(1,1)
    values=(left.lower**exponent,left.upper**exponent)
    return RationalInterval(0 if exponent%2==0 and left.lower<=0<=left.upper else min(values),max(values))


def function_scene(source,*,xmin=-2,xmax=2,samples=65):
    if type(samples) is not int or not 3<=samples<=513:
        raise ValueError('Curva requer 3..513 amostras')
    semantic=SemanticExpression.parse(source)
    if set(n for n,_ in semantic.variable_types)-{'x'}:
        raise ValueError('Curva aceita apenas a variavel x')
    xmin,xmax=rational(xmin),rational(xmax)
    if xmin>=xmax:raise ValueError('Intervalo de curva invalido')
    curves=[];current=[];invalid=0;guarded=0;all_points=[]
    def flush():
        nonlocal current
        if current:curves.append(Polyline('curve'+str(len(curves)),tuple(current)))
        current=[]
    previous=None
    for i in range(samples):
        x=xmin+(xmax-xmin)*i/(samples-1)
        try:
            y=evaluate(semantic.expression,{'x':x});rational(y)
            if previous is not None:
                continuous=True
                for obligation in semantic.obligations:
                    try:
                        bound=_interval(obligation.expression,previous,x)
                        if bound.lower<=0<=bound.upper:continuous=False
                    except (ValueError,ArithmeticError):continuous=False
                if not continuous:flush();guarded+=1
            current.append((x,y));all_points.append((x,y));previous=x
        except (DomainError,ZeroDivisionError):
            flush();previous=None;invalid+=1
    flush()
    if not all_points:raise ValueError('Nenhuma amostra definida no intervalo')
    ys=[y for _,y in all_points];ymin,ymax=min(ys),max(ys);padding=(ymax-ymin)/10 or Fraction(1)
    coordinates=CoordinateSystem(xmin,xmax,ymin-padding,ymax+padding,preserve_aspect=False)
    model={'kind':'function','source':source,'xmin':str(xmin),'xmax':str(xmax),'samples':samples,
           'undefined_samples':invalid,'guarded_intervals':guarded,'continuity_guard':'conservative interval exclusion of domain zeroes'}
    return GeometryScene('Rational function samples',coordinates,curves=tuple(curves),model_json=canonical_json(model))


def vector_field_scene(dx='-y',dy='x',*,bounds=(-2,2,-2,2),grid=9):
    if type(grid) is not int or not 2<=grid<=16 or len(bounds)!=4:
        raise ValueError('Campo requer grade de 2..16 por eixo')
    expressions=(SemanticExpression.parse(dx).expression,SemanticExpression.parse(dy).expression)
    from ..formal.translate import free_symbols
    if any(set(free_symbols(expr))-{'x','y'} for expr in expressions):
        raise ValueError('Campo aceita apenas x e y')
    c=CoordinateSystem(*bounds);arrows=[];undefined=0;stationary=0
    spacing=min(c.xmax-c.xmin,c.ymax-c.ymin)/(grid-1)
    for i in range(grid):
        for j in range(grid):
            x=c.xmin+(c.xmax-c.xmin)*i/(grid-1);y=c.ymin+(c.ymax-c.ymin)*j/(grid-1)
            try:
                u,v=(evaluate(expr,{'x':x,'y':y}) for expr in expressions);rational(u);rational(v)
            except (DomainError,ZeroDivisionError):undefined+=1;continue
            magnitude=max(abs(u),abs(v))
            if not magnitude:stationary+=1;continue
            scale=spacing*Fraction(3,8)/magnitude
            arrows.append(Arrow(f'vector{i}_{j}',(x,y),(x+scale*u,y+scale*v),(u,v)))
    if not arrows:raise ValueError('Campo sem vetores nao nulos definidos')
    model={'kind':'vector_field','dx':dx,'dy':dy,'bounds':[str(rational(v)) for v in bounds],'grid':grid,
           'normalization':'display length scaled by infinity norm; raw vector retained','undefined_samples':undefined,'stationary_samples':stationary}
    return GeometryScene('Vector field',c,arrows=tuple(arrows),model_json=canonical_json(model))


def phase_portrait_scene(dx='y',dy='-x',*,initials=((1,0),(0,1)),duration=6,steps=300,bounds=(-2,2,-2,2),grid=9):
    if type(steps) is not int or not 2<=steps<=2000 or not 1<=len(initials)<=8 or any(len(v)!=2 for v in initials):
        raise ValueError('Retrato requer 1..8 trajetorias e 2..2000 passos')
    duration=rational(duration)
    if not 0<duration<=100:raise ValueError('Duracao deve ser positiva e limitada a 100')
    field=vector_field_scene(dx,dy,bounds=bounds,grid=grid)
    expressions=(parse_expr(dx),parse_expr(dy));curves=[]
    def derivative(time,state):
        values={'x':Fraction(str(state[0])),'y':Fraction(str(state[1]))}
        return tuple(float(evaluate(expr,values)) for expr in expressions)
    normalized=tuple(tuple(rational(v) for v in state) for state in initials)
    for i,state in enumerate(normalized):
        result=integrate(derivative,tuple(float(v) for v in state),0,float(duration),steps,'rk4')
        coordinates=tuple((Fraction(str(x)),Fraction(str(y))) for _,(x,y) in result)
        curves.append(Polyline(f'trajectory{i}',coordinates,'numerical_trajectory'))
    model={'kind':'phase_portrait','dx':dx,'dy':dy,'initials':[[str(v) for v in row] for row in normalized],
           'duration':str(duration),'steps':steps,'method':'rk4_float','bounds':[str(rational(v)) for v in bounds],
           'grid':grid,'limitation':'Numerical trajectories, no experimental validation or analytic guarantee.'}
    return GeometryScene('Phase portrait: RK4 samples',field.coordinates,curves=tuple(curves),arrows=field.arrows,model_json=canonical_json(model))


def adaptive_function_scene(source, *, xmin=-2, xmax=2, tolerance='1/1000', max_segments=1024):
    """Piecewise linear rational graph with certified vertical interpolation error.

    Uses sup|f''| * width²/8 on each interval. The rational AST must be twice
    differentiable throughout the interval; conservative interval failure is
    rejected rather than connecting a curve across a possible pole.
    """
    if type(max_segments) is not int or not 1 <= max_segments <= 2047:
        raise ValueError('Orçamento de segmentos entre 1 e 2047')
    xmin, xmax, tolerance = rational(xmin), rational(xmax), rational(tolerance)
    if xmin >= xmax or tolerance <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Intervalo e tolerância positivos obrigatórios')
    semantic = SemanticExpression.parse(source)
    if set(n for n,_ in semantic.variable_types)-{'x'}:
        raise ValueError('Curva aceita apenas x')
    from ..symbolic import differentiate
    second = differentiate(differentiate(semantic.expression, 'x').derivative, 'x').derivative
    for obligation in semantic.obligations:
        bound = _interval(obligation.expression, xmin, xmax)
        if bound.lower <= 0 <= bound.upper:
            raise ValueError('Não foi possível excluir singularidade em todo o intervalo')
    pending = [(xmin, xmax, 0)]
    accepted = []
    while pending:
        left, right, depth = pending.pop()
        curvature = _interval(second, left, right)
        error = max(abs(curvature.lower), abs(curvature.upper))*(right-left)**2/8
        if error <= tolerance:
            accepted.append((left, right, error))
        else:
            if depth >= 24 or len(accepted)+len(pending)+2 > max_segments:
                raise ValueError('Orçamento insuficiente para certificar tolerância da curva')
            middle = (left+right)/2
            pending.extend(((middle, right, depth+1), (left, middle, depth+1)))
    accepted.sort()
    xs = [accepted[0][0], *(row[1] for row in accepted)]
    points = tuple((x, rational(evaluate(semantic.expression, {'x': x}))) for x in xs)
    low, high = min(y for _,y in points), max(y for _,y in points)
    padding = (high-low)/10 or Fraction(1)
    model = {'kind': 'adaptive_function', 'source': source, 'xmin': str(xmin), 'xmax': str(xmax),
             'tolerance': str(tolerance), 'max_segments': max_segments,
             'segments': [{'left':str(a), 'right':str(b), 'vertical_error_bound':str(e)} for a,b,e in accepted],
             'error_basis': 'exact rational interval bound on second derivative; linear interpolation theorem',
             'scope': 'vertical graph interpolation error, not raster pixels or experimental validity'}
    return GeometryScene('Certified rational curve', CoordinateSystem(xmin,xmax,low-padding,high+padding,
                         preserve_aspect=False), curves=(Polyline('curve0', points),), model_json=canonical_json(model))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Scene:
    task_id: str
    label: str
    points: tuple[tuple[Fraction, Fraction], ...]
    connected: bool = True

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not 1 <= len(self.points) <= 1024:
            raise ValueError("Cena requer de 1 a 1024 pontos")
        object.__setattr__(self, "points", tuple((rational(x), rational(y)) for x, y in self.points))

    def to_data(self) -> dict:
        return {"task_id": self.task_id, "label": self.label, "connected": self.connected,
                "representation": "rational_samples", "points": [[str(x), str(y)] for x, y in self.points]}

    def pixels(self, width: int = 640, height: int = 400) -> tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]:
        if not 64 <= width <= 2048 or not 64 <= height <= 2048:
            raise ValueError("Dimensões de imagem fora do limite")
        xs, ys = zip(*self.points)
        xmin, xmax = min(xs), max(xs)
        ymin, ymax = min(ys), max(ys)
        dx, dy = xmax - xmin or Fraction(1), ymax - ymin or Fraction(1)
        return tuple((20 + round((x - xmin) / dx * (width - 40)),
                      height - 20 - round((y - ymin) / dy * (height - 40))) for x, y in self.points)


def task_scene(task: ScientificTask, solution: tuple[Fraction, ...]) -> Scene:
    if task.family == "polynomial_integral":
        polynomial = PolynomialSpec(task.coefficients)
        points = tuple((Fraction(i, 8), polynomial.evaluate(Fraction(i, 8))) for i in range(-16, 17))
        return Scene(task.content_id, "Integrando: amostras racionais em [-2, 2]; eixos autoescalados", points)
    return Scene(task.content_id, "Solucao: indice da coordenada versus valor; eixos autoescalados",
                 tuple((Fraction(i + 1), rational(value)) for i, value in enumerate(solution)), False)
