def test_frozen_ablation_is_paired_without_selection():
    task = ScientificTask("linear_system", matrix=((2,),), rhs=(4,))
    base = [{"task_id": task.content_id, "values": ["0"]}]
    protocol = FrozenEvaluation.freeze(tasks=[task], baseline=base, policy="fixed test",
        actors=IndependencePolicy("a", "b", "c", "d"),
        lineage=[{"id": task.content_id, "split": "test", "parents": [], "groups": {}},
                 {"id": "train", "split": "train", "parents": [], "groups": {}}])
    good = {"protocol_id": protocol.protocol_id, "predictions": [{"task_id": task.content_id, "values": ["2"]}]}
    bad = {"protocol_id": protocol.protocol_id, "predictions": base}
    variants = {"all": good, "without_feature": bad}
    report = compare_ablations(protocol, variants)
    assert report["comparisons"]["without_feature"] == {"wins": 0, "losses": 1, "ties": 0}
    assert not report["selection_performed"] and verify_ablations(report, protocol, variants)
    report["selection_performed"] = True
    assert not verify_ablations(report, protocol, variants)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        compare_ablations(protocol, {"missing-control": good, "other": bad})


def test_lineage_retractions_propagate_without_mutation():
    a, b, c, d = map(digest, "abcd")
    nodes = [{"id": a, "parents": []}, {"id": b, "parents": [a]},
             {"id": c, "parents": [b]}, {"id": d, "parents": []}]
    graph = LineageGraph.create(nodes)
    before = graph.to_data()
    assert graph.descendants(a) == tuple(sorted([b, c]))
    records = [{"target_id": a, "issuer": "declared operator", "reason": "bad calibration", "evidence_id": digest("evidence")}]
    report = retraction_impact(graph, records)
    assert {row["node_id"] for row in report["alerts"]} == {a, b, c}
    assert not report["historic_content_modified"] and verify_retraction_impact(report, graph, records)
    assert graph.to_data() == before
    report["alerts"].pop()
    assert not verify_retraction_impact(report, graph, records)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        retraction_impact(graph, records*2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        LineageGraph.create(nodes + [{"id": a, "parents": []}])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        LineageGraph.create([{"id": a, "parents": [b]}, {"id": b, "parents": [a]}])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        LineageGraph.create([{"id": a, "parents": [b]}])


def test_long_lineage_does_not_require_recursive_traversal():
    ids = [digest(i) for i in range(1100)]
    graph = LineageGraph.create([{"id": key, "parents": [ids[i-1]] if i else []} for i, key in enumerate(ids)])
    assert len(graph.descendants(ids[0])) == 1099


def test_opaque_snapshots_verify_all_bytes_and_lineage(tmp_path):
    store = SnapshotStore(tmp_path)
    args = dict(weights=b"opaque, never executable", datasets={"train": b"record one"}, code_id=digest("code"), license_id="MIT")
    parent = store.capture(**args)
    assert store.capture(**args) == parent
    child = store.capture(**{**args, "weights": b"second"}, parents=[parent])
    graph = snapshot_lineage(store, [child])
    assert graph.descendants(parent) == (child,)
    manifest = store.get(child)
    manifest["license_id"] = "tampered caller copy"
    assert store.get(child)["license_id"] == "MIT"
    before = sorted(tmp_path.rglob("*"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        store.capture(**{**args, "code_id": "invalid"})
    assert sorted(tmp_path.rglob("*")) == before
    key = store.get(child)["datasets"]["train"]
    (tmp_path / key[:2] / key).write_bytes(b"corrupt")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="corrompido"):
        store.get(child)


def corpus(name, records, split="train"):
    return CorpusManifest.create(name=name, license_id="MIT", provenance="synthetic fixture", split=split, records=records)


def test_corpus_mixture_exact_quotas_and_no_replacement(tmp_path):
    a, b = corpus("a", [digest(i) for i in range(10)]), corpus("b", [digest(i) for i in range(10, 20)])
    registry = CorpusRegistry(tmp_path)
    assert registry.get(registry.register(a)) == a
    weights = {a.content_id: 1, b.content_id: 3}
    report = plan_mixture([a, b], weights, count=8, seed=42)
    assert {row["source_id"]: row["count"] for row in report["allocations"]} == {a.content_id: 2, b.content_id: 6}
    assert len({row["record_id"] for row in report["selections"]}) == 8
    assert plan_mixture([b, a], weights, count=8, seed=42) == report
    assert verify_mixture(report, [a, b], weights, count=8, seed=42)
    report["allocations"][0]["count"] = 99
    assert not verify_mixture(report, [a, b], weights, count=8, seed=42)
    records = {digest(i): str(i).encode() for i in range(10)}
    assert a.verify_records(records)
    records[digest(0)] = b"bad"
    assert not a.verify_records(records)
    singleton = plan_mixture([a], {a.content_id: 1}, count=1, seed=42)
    singleton["count"] = True
    assert not verify_mixture(singleton, [a], {a.content_id: 1}, count=1, seed=42)

def test_mixture_rejects_invalid_or_leaking_plans(case):
    a, b = corpus("a", [digest(1)]), corpus("b", [digest(2)])
    if case == "overlap":
        b = corpus("b", [digest(1)])
    if case == "split":
        b = corpus("b", [digest(2)], "test")
    weights = {a.content_id: 1, b.content_id: 1 if case != "weight" else 0}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        plan_mixture([a, b], weights, count=10 if case == "capacity" else 2, seed=True if case == "seed" else 42)


def test_compute_measurements_do_not_invent_energy():

    task = generate_task('linear_system', 4, 2).task
    p = task.problem
    from fractions import Fraction
    p['matrix'][0] = [str(2*Fraction(v)) for v in p['matrix'][0]]
    p['rhs'][0] = str(2*Fraction(p['rhs'][0]))
    equivalent = TaskSpec('linear_system', p, 2)
    index = NoveltyIndex([task])
    result = index.compare(equivalent)

    assert NoveltyIndex().compare(task)['status'] == 'novelty_not_established'

def test_frozen_protocol_records_null_and_refuted_results():
    hs = [Hypothesis('x', 'linear identity'), Hypothesis('x*x', 'quadratic')]
    calibration = ObservationSet((Observation(0, 0),), 'fixture', 'calibration')
    holdout = ObservationSet((Observation(2, 2), Observation(3, 3)), 'fixture', 'holdout')
    registration = preregister(hs, calibration, protocol='freeze both models before holdout')
    report = evaluate_registration(registration, hs, calibration, holdout)
    assert [r['accepted_on_supplied_holdout'] for r in report['results']] == [True, False]
    assert report == evaluate_registration(registration, hs, calibration, holdout)
    assert report['synthetic'] and not report['external_authentication']
    changed = copy.deepcopy(registration); changed['max_failures'] = 2
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        evaluate_registration(changed, hs, calibration, holdout)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        evaluate_registration(registration, list(reversed(hs)), calibration, holdout)
    leaked = ObservationSet((Observation(0, 0),), 'fixture', 'holdout')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        evaluate_registration(registration, hs, calibration, leaked)

def reviewed(source='forall x in Q: prove x+1 > x', strategy='auto'):
    draft = FormalizationDraft(source, strategy)
    review = FormalizationReview(draft.content_id, 'test reviewer', True,
                                 'Controlled expression and declared domain checked')
    return draft, review


def smt_plan(draft):
    return build_proof_plan(draft, ProofBudget(backends=('smt',), max_attempts=1))


def rehash_run(run):
    for row in run['attempts']:
        if isinstance(row['receipt'], dict):
            row['receipt_content_id'] = fingerprint(row['receipt'])
    run['run_id'] = fingerprint({k: v for k, v in run.items() if k != 'run_id'})
    return run


def rehash_receipt(receipt):
    if 'receipt_id' in receipt:
        receipt['receipt_id'] = fingerprint({k: v for k, v in receipt.items() if k != 'receipt_id'})

    'forall x in Q: prove x/x == 1',
])
def test_controlled_draft_roundtrip(source):
    draft = FormalizationDraft(source)

    assert draft.to_data()['natural_language_semantics_inferred'] is False

def test_repair_changes_only_tactic_and_invalidates_old_review():
    draft, review = reviewed('forall x in Q: prove x*x == x**2')
    repairs = suggest_repairs(draft, failure_kind='timeout', attempted=('auto', 'field'))
    assert repairs
    assert all(r.next_strategy not in ('auto', 'field') for r in repairs)
    for proposal in repairs:
        repaired = proposal.apply(draft)
        assert repaired.statement.to_data() == draft.statement.to_data()
        assert repaired.source == draft.source
        assert verify_repair(proposal.to_data(), draft)
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
            review.require(repaired)
    forged = repairs[0].to_data()
    forged['hypotheses_removed'] = True
    assert not verify_repair(forged, draft)
    stale = FormalizationDraft('forall x in Q: prove x*x == x*x')
    assert not verify_repair(repairs[0].to_data(), stale)

def fake_lean(translation, *, status='failed', axioms=()):
    return LeanCheck(status, translation.statement.content_id, translation.source_hash,
                     'test-double', tuple(axioms), 'controlled test backend', {}, strategy=translation.strategy)


def test_checkpoint_and_portfolio_exhaustion_with_checked_receipt_shapes(monkeypatch):
    draft, review = reviewed()
    budget = ProofBudget(backends=('lean',), strategies=('ring', 'norm_num'), max_attempts=2)
    plan = build_proof_plan(draft, budget)
    monkeypatch.setattr(planner, 'check_lean', lambda translation, **kwargs: fake_lean(translation))
    run = execute_proof_plan(draft, review, plan, stop_after=1)
    assert run['stopped'] == 'checkpoint'
    assert validate_run_structure(run, draft, review, plan)
    assert replay_proof_run(run, draft, review, plan)
    complete = execute_proof_plan(draft, review, plan)
    assert complete['stopped'] == 'portfolio_exhausted'
    assert len(complete['attempts']) == 2
    assert replay_proof_run(complete, draft, review, plan)

"""Analytic references, pixel fixtures and replay attacks for scientific graphics/SCMs."""
from copy import deepcopy
from fractions import Fraction as F

def chain(*, sufficient=True):
    # X = 1 + Ux; M = 2X + Um; Y = -X + 3M + Uy.
    return LinearCausalModel((Equation('X', intercept=1), Equation('M', (Edge('X', 2),)),
        Equation('Y', (Edge('X', -1), Edge('M', 3)))),
        provenance='analytic supplied hypothesis fixture', causal_sufficiency=sufficient)


def graph(rows, sufficient=True):
    return LinearCausalModel(tuple(Equation(name, tuple(Edge(parent, 1) for parent in parents))
        for name, parents in rows), provenance='declared graph fixture', causal_sufficiency=sufficient)


def plot():
    curve = DataCurve('estimate', ((0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 1)), 'fixture-observations',
        (0, 1, 0), (2, 3, 2), 'absolute_bound')
    return ScientificPlot('Measured samples', (curve,), 'time', 'value',
        'supplied synthetic fixture', 'Bounds supplied by operator; no external calibration')


def scene(*, offset=0, title='Geometry'):
    return GeometryScene(title, CoordinateSystem(-2, 2, -2, 2),
        (Point('A', 0, 0), Point('B', 1, offset)), (Segment('AB', 'A', 'B'),))


def test_structural_prediction_and_analytic_total_effect():
    model = chain()
    predicted = model.predict({'X': 2, 'M': 1, 'Y': -2})
    assert predicted == {'X': 3, 'M': 7, 'Y': 16}
    assert model.total_effect('X', 'Y') == 5  # -1 + 3*2, two directed paths.
    assert model.total_effect('Y', 'X') == 0
    assert model.total_effect('X', 'X') == 1
    assert model.abduct(predicted) == {'X': 2, 'M': 1, 'Y': -2}


def test_counterfactual_preserves_individual_disturbances_and_cuts_incoming_edges():
    model = chain()
    receipt = model.counterfactual({'X': 3, 'M': 7, 'Y': 16}, {'M': 0})
    assert receipt['disturbances'] == {'X': '2', 'M': '1', 'Y': '-2'}
    assert receipt['counterfactual'] == {'X': '3', 'M': '0', 'Y': '-5'}
    assert replay_counterfactual(receipt, model)
    # Conditioning M=0 would alter beliefs about its causes; do(M=0) does not change X.
    receipt['counterfactual']['X'] = '0'
    receipt.pop('counterfactual_id')
    receipt['counterfactual_id'] = fingerprint(receipt)
    assert not replay_counterfactual(receipt, model)


def test_multiple_interventions_and_identity_counterfactual():
    model = chain()
    observed = {'X': 3, 'M': 7, 'Y': 16}
    assert model.counterfactual(observed, {})['counterfactual'] == {key: str(value) for key, value in observed.items()}
    changed = model.counterfactual(observed, {'X': 0, 'M': 1})
    assert changed['counterfactual'] == {'X': '0', 'M': '1', 'Y': '1'}


def test_model_serialization_is_canonical_and_unknown_assumptions_rejected():
    model = chain()
    data = json.loads(json.dumps(model.to_data()))
    rebuilt = LinearCausalModel.from_data(data)
    assert rebuilt.model_id == model.model_id
    assert rebuilt.to_data() == data
    data['assumptions'] = ['causality established from correlation']
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        LinearCausalModel.from_data(data)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('equations', [
    (Equation('X', (Edge('Y', 1),)), Equation('Y', (Edge('X', 1),))),
    (Equation('X', (Edge('Missing', 1),)),),
    (Equation('X'), Equation('X')),

def test_chain_fork_and_collider_d_separation():
    causal_chain = graph((('X', ()), ('M', ('X',)), ('Y', ('M',))))
    assert not causal_chain.d_separated({'X'}, {'Y'})
    assert causal_chain.d_separated({'X'}, {'Y'}, conditioned={'M'})
    fork = graph((('Z', ()), ('X', ('Z',)), ('Y', ('Z',))))
    assert not fork.d_separated({'X'}, {'Y'})
    assert fork.d_separated({'X'}, {'Y'}, conditioned={'Z'})
    collider = graph((('X', ()), ('Y', ()), ('C', ('X', 'Y')), ('D', ('C',))))
    assert collider.d_separated({'X'}, {'Y'})
    assert not collider.d_separated({'X'}, {'Y'}, conditioned={'C'})
    assert not collider.d_separated({'X'}, {'Y'}, conditioned={'D'})


def test_backdoor_adjustment_rejects_descendants_and_unknown_confounding():
    model = graph((('Z', ()), ('X', ('Z',)), ('Y', ('X', 'Z')), ('D', ('X',))))
    assert not model.backdoor_adjustment('X', 'Y')['identified_under_declared_assumptions']
    adjusted = model.backdoor_adjustment('X', 'Y', adjustment=('Z',))
    assert adjusted['identified_under_declared_assumptions']
    assert not adjusted['empirical_causal_identification_verified']
    invalid = model.backdoor_adjustment('X', 'Y', adjustment=('Z', 'D'))
    assert invalid['descendants_in_adjustment'] == ['D']
    assert not invalid['identified_under_declared_assumptions']
    assert not chain(sufficient=False).backdoor_adjustment('X', 'Y')['identified_under_declared_assumptions']

def png(size, pixels):
    Image = pytest.importorskip('PIL.Image')
    image = Image.new('RGBA', size)
    image.putdata(pixels)
    output = BytesIO()
    image.save(output, format='PNG')
    return output.getvalue()


def test_pixel_metrics_match_analytic_rgba_reference_and_bound_changes():
    baseline = png((2, 2), [(0, 0, 0, 255)] * 4)
    candidate = png((2, 2), [(0, 0, 0, 255), (4, 0, 0, 255), (0, 0, 0, 255), (0, 0, 0, 255)])
    receipt = compare_pixels(baseline, candidate, maximum_changed_fraction='1/4', maximum_mean_error='1/4')
    assert receipt['accepted']
    assert receipt['changed_pixels'] == 1
    assert receipt['changed_fraction'] == '1/4'
    assert receipt['mean_absolute_error'] == '1/4'  # 4 / (4 pixels * 4 channels).
    assert receipt['maximum_channel_error'] == 4
    assert receipt['changed_bounds'] == [1, 0, 1, 0]
    assert replay_pixel_comparison(receipt, baseline, candidate)
    assert not compare_pixels(baseline, candidate)['accepted']
    receipt['accepted'] = False
    receipt.pop('comparison_id')
    receipt['comparison_id'] = fingerprint(receipt)
    assert not replay_pixel_comparison(receipt, baseline, candidate)


def test_pixel_alpha_policy_and_channel_tolerance_are_explicit():

    right = png((1, 1), [(0, 0, 255, 0)])
    assert not compare_pixels(left, right)['accepted']
    assert compare_pixels(left, right, alpha_policy='composite_white')['accepted']
    # Tolerating channels does not silently waive the independent mean threshold.
    receipt = compare_pixels(left, right, channel_tolerance=255)
    assert receipt['changed_pixels'] == 0 and not receipt['accepted']
    assert compare_pixels(left, right, channel_tolerance=255, maximum_mean_error=255)['accepted']

"""Manufactured integrals and independent mesh validation grids."""
from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import replace
from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import repeat
import json
import math

import pytest

from nablamath.math.polynomials.univariate import Polynomial as P
from nablamath.math.calculus.risch import (
    LinearFactor, PrimitiveTerm, RationalIntegral, integrate_rational,
)
from nablamath.worlds.mesh.adaptive import (
    Mesh1D, adaptive_interpolate, estimate_cells, refine_mesh,
    sampled_error, uniform_mesh,

def polynomial_power(poly, exponent):
    result = P((1,))
    for _ in range(exponent):
        result = result*poly
    return result


def denominator_from_factors(factors, scale=1):
    result = P((scale,))
    for factor in factors:
        result = result*polynomial_power(P((-factor.root, 1)), factor.multiplicity)
    return result


@pytest.mark.parametrize('coefficients', [(0,), (1,), (2, 3, -4), (F(1, 3), F(-2, 7), F(5, 9))])
def test_polynomial_integration_exact(coefficients):
    numerator = P(coefficients)
    result = integrate_rational(numerator, P((1,)))
    assert result.verify()
    assert result.polynomial_part.derivative() == numerator
    assert result.terms == ()
    assert result.excluded_roots == ()
    expected = sum(float(c)/(i+1) for i, c in enumerate(coefficients))
    assert result.definite(0, 1) == pytest.approx(expected)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('root', [F(0), F(-2), F(3, 7)])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('multiplicity', [1, 2, 3, 5])
def test_single_pole_known_partial_fraction(root, multiplicity):
    factors = (LinearFactor(root, multiplicity),)
    denominator = denominator_from_factors(factors)
    coefficient = F(7, 3)
    result = integrate_rational(P((coefficient,)), denominator, factors)
    assert result.verify()
    assert len(result.terms) == 1
    term = result.terms[0]
    assert term.root == root
    if multiplicity == 1:
        assert (term.coefficient, term.power) == (coefficient, 0)
    else:
        assert (term.coefficient, term.power) == (coefficient/(1-multiplicity), 1-multiplicity)
    left, right = float(root)+1, float(root)+2
    expected = float(coefficient)*math.log(2) if multiplicity == 1 else float(coefficient)*(2**(1-multiplicity)-1)/(1-multiplicity)
    assert result.definite(left, right) == pytest.approx(expected)


def test_three_distinct_poles_known_decomposition():
    # 1/x + 2/(x-1) - 3/(x+2) = (8x-2)/(x(x-1)(x+2)).
    factors = (LinearFactor(0), LinearFactor(1), LinearFactor(-2))
    denominator = denominator_from_factors(factors)
    result = integrate_rational(P((-2, 8)), denominator, factors)
    assert result.verify()
    assert {(t.root, t.coefficient, t.power) for t in result.terms} == {
        (F(0), F(1), 0), (F(1), F(2), 0), (F(-2), F(-3), 0),
    }


def test_mixed_repeated_factors_and_polynomial_part():
    factors = (LinearFactor(-1, 3), LinearFactor(2, 2))
    denominator = denominator_from_factors(factors, scale=F(5, 3))
    # Manufacture integrand from independently specified primitive derivative.
    polynomial = P((3, -2, F(1, 2)))
    terms = (PrimitiveTerm(F(4, 7), -1, 0), PrimitiveTerm(-2, -1, -2),
             PrimitiveTerm(3, 2, -1))
    numerator = polynomial.derivative()*denominator
    for term in terms:
        n, d = term.derivative_pair()
        quotient, rest = denominator.divmod(d)
        assert rest.is_zero
        numerator = numerator+n*quotient
    result = integrate_rational(numerator, denominator, reversed(factors))
    assert result.verify()
    assert result.polynomial_part.derivative() == polynomial.derivative()
    assert set(result.terms) == set(terms)
    # Constants of integration differ, but primitive differences must match.
    for left, right in [(3., 4.), (-4., -3.), (0., 1.)]:
        expected = float(polynomial(F(right))-polynomial(F(left)))
        expected += sum(term.evaluate(right)-term.evaluate(left) for term in terms)
        assert result.definite(left, right) == pytest.approx(expected)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('denominator,factors', [
    (P((-2, 1)), (LinearFactor(2),)),
    (P((1, -2, 1)), (LinearFactor(1, 2),)),
    (P((-2, 1, 1)), (LinearFactor(-2), LinearFactor(1))),
    (P((F(1, 4), -1, 1)), (LinearFactor(F(1, 2), 2),)),
])
def test_automatic_low_degree_factorization(denominator, factors):
    automatic = integrate_rational(P((1,)), denominator)
    explicit = integrate_rational(P((1,)), denominator, factors)
    assert automatic == explicit


def test_preserve_removable_domain_exclusions():
    denominator = P((-1, 1))
    result = integrate_rational(denominator, denominator)
    assert result.terms == ()
    assert result.excluded_roots == (F(1),)
    assert result.verify()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='excluded'):
        result.evaluate(1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='exclusion'):
        result.definite(0, 2)
    assert result.definite(2, 3) == pytest.approx(1)
    assert result.definite(3, 2) == pytest.approx(-1)
    assert result.definite(2, 2) == 0


def test_integral_replay_roundtrip_and_tampering():
    result = integrate_rational(P((2, 1)), P((-2, 1, 1)))
    payload = json.loads(json.dumps(result.to_data()))
    replay = RationalIntegral.from_data(payload)
    assert replay == result
    assert replay.definite(2, 3) == result.definite(2, 3)
    for key, replacement in [('version', 2), ('version', True), ('numerator', ['999']),
                             ('terms', []), ('factors', [])]:
        bad = deepcopy(payload)
        bad[key] = replacement
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            RationalIntegral.from_data(bad)
    extra = deepcopy(payload)
    extra['unexpected'] = 1
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        RationalIntegral.from_data(extra)
    bad_term = deepcopy(payload)
    bad_term['terms'][0]['root'] = '999'
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        RationalIntegral.from_data(bad_term)

    assert not replace(result, terms=(PrimitiveTerm(2, 0, 0),)).verify()
    assert not replace(result, factors=(LinearFactor(1),)).verify()
    assert not replace(result, version=123).verify()

def test_mesh_linear_profile_exact_interpolation_integration():
    mesh = uniform_mesh(lambda x: 3*x-2, -2, 4, cells=5)
    assert mesh.cell_count == 5
    assert mesh.domain == (-2, 4)
    for x in (-2, -.7, 0, 1.25, 4):
        assert mesh.interpolate(x) == pytest.approx(3*x-2)
    assert all(mesh.slope(i) == pytest.approx(3) for i in range(mesh.cell_count))
    assert mesh.integrate() == pytest.approx(6)
    assert mesh.integrate(-1, 2) == pytest.approx(-1.5)
    assert mesh.integrate(2, -1) == pytest.approx(1.5)
    assert mesh.integrate(1, 1) == 0


def test_nonuniform_mesh_localization_and_trapezoid():
    mesh = Mesh1D((0, .1, .4, 1), (0, 1, 0, 2))
    assert mesh.locate(0) == 0
    assert mesh.locate(.1) == 1
    assert mesh.locate(1) == 2
    assert mesh.widths == pytest.approx((.1, .3, .6))
    assert mesh.interpolate(.7) == pytest.approx(1)
    assert mesh.integrate() == pytest.approx(.8)


def test_quadratic_error_indicator_matches_analytic_bound():
    mesh = uniform_mesh(lambda x: x*x, 0, 1, cells=4)
    indicators = estimate_cells(mesh, lambda x: x*x, absolute_tolerance=.001,
                                second_derivative_bound=lambda a, b: 2)
    for indicator in indicators:
        exact_error = (indicator.right-indicator.left)**2 / 4
        assert indicator.sampled_error == pytest.approx(exact_error)
        assert indicator.curvature_bound == pytest.approx(exact_error)
        assert indicator.needs_refinement


def test_refinement_preserves_original_nodes_and_values():
    mesh = uniform_mesh(lambda x: x*x, 0, 1, cells=4)
    refined = refine_mesh(mesh, (1, 3, 1), lambda x: x*x)
    assert refined.cell_count == 6
    assert refined.nodes == (0, .25, .375, .5, .75, .875, 1)
    for x, value in zip(mesh.nodes, mesh.values):
        assert refined.interpolate(x) == value
    assert refine_mesh(mesh, (), lambda x: 99) == mesh


@pytest.mark.parametrize('profile,left,right', [
    (lambda x: x*x, -1, 1), (math.exp, 0, 1),
    (math.sin, 0, math.pi), (lambda x: 1/(1+25*x*x), -1, 1),
])
def test_adaptive_profiles_against_independent_dense_grid(profile, left, right):
    result = adaptive_interpolate(profile, left, right, absolute_tolerance=1e-4,
                                  max_cells=2048, max_evaluations=100000)
    assert result.converged
    assert result.reason == 'sampled_tolerance'
    assert all(not i.needs_refinement for i in result.indicators)
    # Irrational-looking validation offsets differ from estimator quarter-points.
    validation = [left+(right-left)*(i+.173205)/(2001) for i in range(2001)]
    assert sampled_error(result.mesh, profile, validation) < 1.1e-4
    assert result.evaluations >= len(result.mesh.nodes)
    assert result.history[-1].cells == result.mesh.cell_count


def test_refinement_localizes_narrow_feature():
    profile = lambda x: math.exp(-80*(x-.25)**2)
    result = adaptive_interpolate(profile, 0, 1, absolute_tolerance=1e-3)
    assert result.converged
    near = [b-a for a, b in zip(result.mesh.nodes, result.mesh.nodes[1:]) if .1 <= a <= .4]
    far = [b-a for a, b in zip(result.mesh.nodes, result.mesh.nodes[1:]) if a >= .75]
    assert max(near) < max(far)


def test_adaptive_cache_determinism_and_replay():
    calls = []
    def profile(x):
        calls.append(x)
        return x*x
    result = adaptive_interpolate(profile, 0, 1, absolute_tolerance=.001)
    assert len(calls) == len(set(calls)) == result.evaluations
    rerun = adaptive_interpolate(lambda x: x*x, 0, 1, absolute_tolerance=.001)
    assert result == rerun
    payload = json.loads(json.dumps(result.to_data()))
    mesh = Mesh1D.from_data(payload['mesh'])
    assert mesh == result.mesh
    assert mesh.interpolate(.333) == result.mesh.interpolate(.333)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('options,reason', [
    ({'max_iterations': 0}, 'iteration_budget'),
    ({'max_cells': 4}, 'cell_budget'),
    ({'max_evaluations': 5}, 'evaluation_budget'),
])
def test_budget_statuses_are_explicit(options, reason):
    result = adaptive_interpolate(lambda x: x*x, 0, 1, absolute_tolerance=1e-8, **options)
    assert not result.converged
    assert result.reason == reason
    assert result.mesh.cell_count == 4


def test_relative_tolerance_scale_invariance():
    small = adaptive_interpolate(lambda x: math.exp(x), 0, 1,
                                  absolute_tolerance=0, relative_tolerance=.001)
    large = adaptive_interpolate(lambda x: 1000*math.exp(x), 0, 1,
                                  absolute_tolerance=0, relative_tolerance=.001)
    assert small.mesh.nodes == large.mesh.nodes
    assert small.converged and large.converged


def test_sampled_estimators_do_not_claim_global_bounds():
    # This profile vanishes at all initial estimator samples but not between.
    profile = lambda x: math.sin(16*math.pi*x)
    result = adaptive_interpolate(profile, 0, 1, initial_cells=4, absolute_tolerance=1e-10)
    assert result.converged
    assert sampled_error(result.mesh, profile, [.03125]) > .99
    assert all(i.curvature_bound is None for i in result.indicators)

"""Independent analytic identities and reference results for bounded APIs."""
import math
from dataclasses import replace
from fractions import Fraction
import pytest
from nablamath.math.calculus.transcendentals import lambert_w
from nablamath.math.linear_algebra.matrices import Matrix, identity

@pytest.mark.parametrize('w,branch', [(-20., -1), (-2., -1), (-.8, 0), (-.01, 0),
                                      (1., 0), (10., 0), (500., 0)])
def test_lambert_inverse_known_values(w, branch):
    assert lambert_w(w * math.exp(w), branch) == pytest.approx(w, rel=1e-11)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('x', [1e-300, -1e-300, 1e300])
def test_lambert_extreme_finite_domains(x):
    w = lambert_w(x)
    assert w * math.exp(w) == pytest.approx(x, rel=1e-10, abs=0)


def test_lambert_domains_and_budget():
    assert lambert_w(-1 / math.e) == -1
    assert lambert_w(-1 / math.e, -1) == -1
    assert lambert_w(0) == 0
    for x, branch in [(-1, 0), (0, -1), (1, -1), (math.inf, 0)]:
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            lambert_w(x, branch)
    with pytest.raises(ArithmeticError):
        lambert_w(3, max_iterations=1)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('rows', [((0, 2), (3, 4)), ((0, 1, 1), (2, 0, 3), (4, 5, 6)),
                                    ((0, 1), (0, 2)), ((1, 2), (2, 4)),
                                    ((Fraction(1, 3), 2), (3, Fraction(7, 2)))])
def test_exact_lu_certificate(rows):
    a = Matrix(rows)
    result = pivoted_lu(a)
    assert result.verify(a)
    assert result.permutation @ a == result.lower @ result.upper
    if a.shape[0] == 2 and a.rows[0][0] == 0 and a.rows[1][0]:
        assert result.permutation != identity(2)
    assert not replace(result, upper=identity(a.shape[0])).verify(a)


def test_lu_reject_rectangular():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        pivoted_lu(Matrix(((1, 2, 3),)))


@pytest.mark.parametrize('n,factors', [(1, ()), (2, (2,)), (81, (3, 3, 3, 3)),
    (600851475143, (71, 839, 1471, 6857)), (1000003 * 1000033, (1000003, 1000033)),
    (2**63, (2,) * 63)])
def test_factorization_known_reference(n, factors):
    assert factorize64(n) == factors
    assert verify_factorization(n, factors)
    assert not verify_factorization(n, factors + (2,))


def test_primality_trial_division_independent():
    for n in range(2000):
        reference = n >= 2 and all(n % p for p in range(2, math.isqrt(n) + 1))
        assert is_prime64(n) == reference
    assert is_prime64(18446744073709551557)
    assert not is_prime64(341550071728321)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        is_prime64(2**64)
    with pytest.raises(ArithmeticError):
        factorize64(1000003 * 1000033, max_iterations=1)


def test_backward_euler_stiff_decay_reference():
    result = backward_euler(lambda t, y: -1000 * y, lambda t, y: -1000,
                            1., 0., .5, 5, tolerance=1e-16)
    assert result.values[-1] == pytest.approx(101**-5, rel=1e-4, abs=1e-16)
    assert all(abs(y) <= 1 for y in result.values)


def test_backward_euler_refines_against_analytic_solution():
    errors = []
    for steps in (20, 40, 80):
        result = backward_euler(lambda t, y: -y, lambda t, y: -1, 1., 0., 1., steps)
        errors.append(abs(result.values[-1] - math.exp(-1)))
    assert errors[2] < errors[1] < errors[0]


def test_implicit_event_linear_trajectory():
    result = backward_euler(lambda t, y: -1, lambda t, y: 0, 1., 0., 2., 8,
                            event=lambda t, y: y - .3)
    assert result.event_time == pytest.approx(.7)
    assert result.values[-1] == pytest.approx(.3)
    initial = backward_euler(lambda t, y: 1, lambda t, y: 0, 0., 0., 2., 8,
                             event=lambda t, y: y)
    assert initial.event_time == 0


def test_implicit_failure_paths():
    with pytest.raises(ArithmeticError):
        backward_euler(lambda t, y: y + 1, lambda t, y: 1, 0., 0., 1., 1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        backward_euler(lambda t, y: math.nan, lambda t, y: 0, 0., 0., 1., 1)
    with pytest.raises(ArithmeticError):
        backward_euler(lambda t, y: -y*y, lambda t, y: -2*y, 1., 0., 1., 1,
                       max_iterations=1)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('branch', [0, -1])
def test_lambert_branchpoint_independent_decimal_newton(branch):
    from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
    x = math.nextafter(-1 / math.e, 0)
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 70
        dx = Decimal.from_float(x)
        offset = (2 * (1 + dx * Decimal(1).exp())).sqrt()
        reference = -1 + offset if branch == 0 else -1 - offset
        for _ in range(20):
            exp = reference.exp()
            reference -= (reference*exp-dx)/(exp*(reference+1))
        assert abs(lambert_w(x, branch) - float(reference)) < 1e-13


def test_implicit_last_newton_update_is_checked():
    result = backward_euler(lambda t, y: -y, lambda t, y: -1,
                            1., 0., 1., 1, max_iterations=1)
    assert result.values[-1] == .5


def test_implicit_rejects_unrepresentable_time_grid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='not representable'):
        backward_euler(lambda t, y: -y, lambda t, y: -1,
                       1., 1e16, 1e16+2, 100)

    assert reputation.record('alice', '1', violation=True, reason='invalid result')
    assert not reputation.record('alice', '1', violation=True, reason='invalid result')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        reputation.record('mallory', '1', violation=False, reason='changed')
    reputation.record('alice', '2', violation=False, reason='valid result')
    assert reputation.report('alice')['blocked']
    assert reputation.report('alice')['scientific_truth_score'] is None
    audit = reputation.audit()
    audit[0]['peer_id'] = 'mutated'
    assert reputation.audit()[0]['peer_id'] == 'alice'


def test_moderation_quarantines_forgery_without_penalizing_claimed_peer(signed, tmp_path):
    _, trust, envelope = signed
    gate = ModerationGate(MessageVerifier(trust, 'bob'), Quarantine(tmp_path))
    forged = copy.deepcopy(envelope)
    forged['payload']['claim'] = 'poisoned'
    denied = gate.receive(json.dumps(forged).encode(), source='transport-1', now_unix=100)
    assert not denied['accepted'] and denied['quarantine_id']
    assert gate.reputation.report('alice')['observations'] == 0
    accepted = gate.receive(json.dumps(envelope).encode(), source='transport-1', now_unix=100)
    assert accepted['accepted'] and accepted['payload'] == {'claim': 1}
    assert not gate.receive(json.dumps(envelope).encode(), source='transport-1', now_unix=100)['accepted']
    assert not gate.receive(b'{bad', source='transport-1', now_unix=100)['accepted']

"""Independent analytic/structural checks for bounded physics profiles.

No fixture is presented as an authenticated physical experiment. Smooth Euler

@pytest.mark.parametrize('gamma', [1.1, 1.4, 5/3, 2.0])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('velocity', [-20, 0, 30])
def test_ideal_gas_round_trip_and_analytic_energy(gamma, velocity):
    primitive = PrimitiveState(2, velocity, 100)
    conservative = primitive.conservative(gamma)
    assert conservative.density == 2
    assert conservative.momentum == 2*velocity
    assert conservative.energy == pytest.approx(100/(gamma-1)+velocity**2)
    actual = conservative.primitive(gamma)
    assert actual.density == pytest.approx(2)
    assert actual.velocity == pytest.approx(velocity)
    assert actual.pressure == pytest.approx(100)
    assert primitive.sound_speed(gamma) == pytest.approx(math.sqrt(gamma*50))

    assert result.primitive_states == tuple(initial)
    assert result.conservation_residual == (0,0,0)
    assert result.to_data()['experimental_validation'] is False


def test_zero_duration_has_no_attempted_work():
    initial = [PrimitiveState(1,2,3)]*2
    result = solve_euler_1d(initial,0)
    assert result.steps == result.attempted_cell_updates == 0
    assert result.primitive_states[0].velocity == 2


def test_periodic_uniform_moving_state_and_conservation():
    state = PrimitiveState(1.2,-2.5,2)
    result = solve_euler_1d([state]*20,.1,config=Euler1DConfig(boundary='periodic'))
    for final in result.primitive_states:
        assert final.density == pytest.approx(state.density)
        assert final.velocity == pytest.approx(state.velocity)
        assert final.pressure == pytest.approx(state.pressure)
    assert result.boundary_transport == (0,0,0)
    assert max(map(abs,result.conservation_residual)) < 1e-13


def test_euler_smooth_contact_transport_refines_against_exact_advection():
    # Constant pressure and velocity: any advected positive density is an
    # exact ideal-Euler contact field, giving an independent analytic reference.
    errors = []
    for cells in (24,48):
        initial = [PrimitiveState(1+.2*math.sin(2*math.pi*(i+.5)/cells),1,1)
                   for i in range(cells)]
        result = solve_euler_1d(initial,.1,config=Euler1DConfig(boundary='periodic'))
        error = sum(abs(s.density-(1+.2*math.sin(2*math.pi*(x-.1))))
                    for x,s in zip(result.cell_centers_m,result.primitive_states))/cells
        errors.append(error)
        assert max(map(abs,result.conservation_residual)) < 1e-12
        assert max(abs(s.velocity-1) for s in result.primitive_states) < 1e-12
        assert max(abs(s.pressure-1) for s in result.primitive_states) < 1e-12
    assert errors[1] < .65*errors[0]


def test_sod_shock_tube_positive_and_near_analytic_contact_plateau():
    initial = shock_tube_initial(120,PrimitiveState(1,0,1),PrimitiveState(.125,0,.1))
    result = solve_euler_1d(initial,.15)
    states = result.primitive_states
    assert all(s.density > 0 and s.pressure > 0 for s in states)
    # Standard ideal-gas Sod Riemann star state (gamma=1.4): p*=.30313,
    # u*=.92745; x~.571 lies between the rarefaction tail and contact.
    center = states[68]
    assert center.pressure == pytest.approx(.30313,abs=.02)
    assert center.velocity == pytest.approx(.92745,abs=.04)
    assert max(map(abs,result.conservation_residual)) < 1e-12


def test_reflecting_walls_conserve_mass_energy_and_account_momentum():
    initial = shock_tube_initial(30,PrimitiveState(1,.5,1),PrimitiveState(.5,-.2,.5))
    result = solve_euler_1d(initial,.05,config=Euler1DConfig(boundary='reflecting'))
    assert result.final_integrals[0] == pytest.approx(result.initial_integrals[0],abs=1e-13)
    assert result.final_integrals[2] == pytest.approx(result.initial_integrals[2],abs=1e-13)
    assert result.boundary_transport[0] == result.boundary_transport[2] == 0
    assert max(map(abs,result.conservation_residual)) < 1e-12


@pytest.mark.parametrize('mach', [1.01, 2, 5, 20])
def test_normal_shock_matches_independent_rankine_hugoniot_and_entropy(mach):
    gamma = 1.4
    upstream = PrimitiveState(1,mach*math.sqrt(gamma),1)
    downstream = normal_shock_downstream(upstream,gamma)
    assert downstream.density > upstream.density
    assert downstream.pressure > upstream.pressure
    assert downstream.velocity/downstream.sound_speed(gamma) < 1
    # Ideal-gas entropy grows across the physically admissible compression shock.
    assert downstream.pressure/downstream.density**gamma > .999999999999
    residual = rankine_hugoniot_residual(upstream,downstream,0,gamma)
    scales = physical_flux(upstream.conservative(gamma),gamma)
    assert all(abs(r) < 1e-12*max(1,abs(s)) for r,s in zip(residual,scales))

def _shear_samples(kappa=.42):
    rows = []
    for i,(y,g) in enumerate(((.02,4),(.04,-3),(.08,2),(.1,-1))):
        rho,nu = 1.2,.0001
        tau = rho*(nu+(kappa*y)**2*abs(g))*g
        rows.append(ShearMeasurement(str(i),y,g,tau,rho,nu,'synthetic analytic closure',True,weight=i+1))
    return rows


def test_calibration_recovers_prescribed_parameter_and_retains_evidence_scope():
    result = calibrate_mixing_length(_shear_samples())
    assert result.model.kappa == pytest.approx(.42,abs=1e-14)
    assert result.weighted_squared_residual_pa2 < 1e-28
    assert result.parameter_at_bound is False
    data = result.to_data()
    assert data['synthetic_present'] is True
    assert data['source_authenticity_verified'] is False
    assert data['holdout_validation_performed'] is False
    assert all(row['source'] == 'synthetic analytic closure' for row in data['comparisons'])


def test_calibration_constrained_optimum_is_declared():
    result = calibrate_mixing_length(_shear_samples(.8),minimum_kappa=.2,maximum_kappa=.5)
    assert result.model.kappa == .5
    assert result.parameter_at_bound is True
    assert result.weighted_squared_residual_pa2 > 0


def test_calibration_rejects_degenerate_duplicate_and_capped_measurements():
    samples = _shear_samples()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='unique'):
        calibrate_mixing_length([samples[0],samples[0]])
    zeros = [ShearMeasurement(str(i),0,1,0,1,0,'fixture',True) for i in range(2)]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='unidentifiable'):
        calibrate_mixing_length(zeros)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='cap'):
        calibrate_mixing_length(samples,max_eddy_viscosity_m2_s=1e-8)

def test_cubic_material_stress_tangent_energy_derivative():
    material = CubicElasticMaterial(100,300)
    eps,h = .03,1e-6
    assert material.stress_pa(eps) == pytest.approx(100*eps+300*eps**3)
    finite_tangent = (material.stress_pa(eps+h)-material.stress_pa(eps-h))/(2*h)
    assert material.tangent_pa(eps) == pytest.approx(finite_tangent,rel=1e-10)
    energy_derivative = (material.energy_density_j_m3(eps+h)-material.energy_density_j_m3(eps-h))/(2*h)
    assert material.stress_pa(eps) == pytest.approx(energy_derivative,rel=1e-9)
    assert material.stress_pa(-eps) == -material.stress_pa(eps)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('elements', [1, 2, 10, 100])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('force', [-2, 0, 2])
def test_nonlinear_fe_reduces_to_independent_linear_bar_formula(elements,force):
    bar = NonlinearBar.uniform(2,.5,CubicElasticMaterial(1000),force,elements=elements)
    result = solve_nonlinear_bar(bar,load_steps=2)
    exact_end = force*2/(.5*1000)
    assert result.displacements_m[-1] == pytest.approx(exact_end,abs=1e-13)
    for i,u in enumerate(result.displacements_m):
        assert u == pytest.approx(exact_end*i/elements,abs=1e-13)
    assert result.reaction_n == pytest.approx(-force,abs=1e-10)
    assert result.strain_energy_j == pytest.approx(force*exact_end/2,abs=1e-13)
    assert result.total_potential_energy_j == pytest.approx(-force*exact_end/2,abs=1e-13)
    assert result.to_data()['experimental_validation'] is False


def test_nonlinear_uniform_bar_prescribed_strain_and_force():
    material = CubicElasticMaterial(50,3000)
    strain = .04
    force = .2*(50*strain+3000*strain**3)
    result = solve_nonlinear_bar(NonlinearBar.uniform(3,.2,material,force,elements=5))
    assert result.displacements_m[-1] == pytest.approx(3*strain,rel=1e-9)
    assert result.element_strains == pytest.approx([strain]*5,rel=1e-9)
    assert result.reaction_n == pytest.approx(-force,rel=1e-9)
    assert result.residual_norm_n < 1e-9


def test_heterogeneous_series_elements_and_internal_nodal_loads():
    # Prescribe strains; compute loads independently from the constitutive law.
    strains = (.02,-.01,.03)
    lengths = (1,2,.5)
    areas = (.5,.3,.8)
    young = (100,200,50)
    hardening = (1000,500,300)
    axial = [a*(e*s+h*s**3) for a,e,h,s in zip(areas,young,hardening,strains)]
    loads = (0,axial[0]-axial[1],axial[1]-axial[2],axial[2])
    elements = tuple(AxialElement(l,a,CubicElasticMaterial(e,h)) for l,a,e,h in zip(lengths,areas,young,hardening))
    result = solve_nonlinear_bar(NonlinearBar(elements,loads),load_steps=6)
    assert result.element_strains == pytest.approx(strains,abs=1e-10)
    assert result.reaction_n == pytest.approx(-sum(loads),abs=1e-9)
    expected_u = [0]
    for length,strain in zip(lengths,strains):
        expected_u.append(expected_u[-1]+length*strain)
    assert result.displacements_m == pytest.approx(expected_u,abs=1e-10)


def test_assembled_tangent_and_force_are_energy_derivatives():
    bar = NonlinearBar.uniform(2,.5,CubicElasticMaterial(100,3000),1,elements=3)
    u = (0,.01,.015,.025)
    assembly = assemble_nonlinear_bar(bar,u)
    h = 1e-7
    for j in range(1,4):
        plus,minus = list(u),list(u)
        plus[j] += h
        minus[j] -= h
        ap,am = assemble_nonlinear_bar(bar,plus),assemble_nonlinear_bar(bar,minus)
        numerical_force = (ap.strain_energy_j-am.strain_energy_j)/(2*h)
        assert assembly.internal_forces_n[j] == pytest.approx(numerical_force,rel=1e-8)
        for i in range(1,4):
            numerical = (ap.internal_forces_n[i]-am.internal_forces_n[i])/(2*h)
            expected = assembly.free_diagonal_n_m[i-1] if i == j else (
                assembly.free_offdiagonal_n_m[min(i,j)-1] if abs(i-j) == 1 else 0)
            assert numerical == pytest.approx(expected,rel=1e-8,abs=1e-8)


def test_strong_nonlinearity_uses_backtracking_and_continuation_agrees():
    bar = NonlinearBar.uniform(1,1,CubicElasticMaterial(1,100000),1,elements=3)
    direct = solve_nonlinear_bar(bar,load_steps=1)
    continued = solve_nonlinear_bar(bar,load_steps=12)
    assert any(alpha < 1 for alpha in direct.continuation[0].accepted_line_search_factors)
    assert direct.displacements_m == pytest.approx(continued.displacements_m,abs=1e-10)
    eps = direct.displacements_m[-1]
    assert eps+100000*eps**3 == pytest.approx(1,abs=1e-9)


def test_one_newton_update_can_converge_on_linear_material():
    bar = NonlinearBar.uniform(1,1,CubicElasticMaterial(100),1,elements=2)
    result = solve_nonlinear_bar(bar,load_steps=1,max_newton_iterations=1)
    assert result.continuation[0].newton_iterations == 1
    assert result.displacements_m[-1] == pytest.approx(.01)


def test_nonlinear_failures_never_masquerade_as_converged_results():
    material = CubicElasticMaterial(100,10000)
    bar = NonlinearBar.uniform(1,1,material,1,elements=3)
    with pytest.raises(ArithmeticError,match='element-evaluation'):

    with pytest.raises(ArithmeticError,match='Newton iteration'):
        solve_nonlinear_bar(bar,load_steps=1,max_newton_iterations=1)
    impossible = NonlinearBar.uniform(1,1,CubicElasticMaterial(1,maximum_abs_strain=.01),1,elements=2)
    with pytest.raises(ArithmeticError):
        solve_nonlinear_bar(impossible,load_steps=1,max_line_searches=5)

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

def test_all_profiles_and_transactional_cooperative_reservations():
    profiles = [ResourceProfile.load(path) for path in sorted((ROOT / "configs/profiles").glob("*.yaml"))]
    assert len(profiles) == 5
    profile = next(p for p in profiles if p.name == "cpu_conservative")
    reservations = ResourceReservations(profile)
    with reservations.reserve(memory_bytes=profile.memory_bytes):
        assert reservations.used == (1, profile.memory_bytes, 0, 1)
        def blocked(_):
            with pytest.raises(ValueError):
                with reservations.reserve():
                    raise AssertionError("Admission should reject before work")
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as executor:
            list(executor.map(blocked, range(16)))
    assert reservations.used == (0, 0, 0, 0)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        with reservations.reserve():
            raise RuntimeError("Failed task releases its reservation")
    assert reservations.used == (0, 0, 0, 0)
    for request in [{"gpu_memory_bytes": 1}, {"distributed": True}, {"cpu_slots": True},
                    {"seconds": profile.max_task_seconds+1}, {"memory_bytes": -1}]:
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            with reservations.reserve(**request):
                pass

def make_wheel(path, *, tamper=None, extra=None, unsafe=None):
    files = {"example/__init__.py": b"raise RuntimeError('must never execute')\n",
             "example-1.dist-info/METADATA": b"Metadata-Version: 2.1\nName: example\nVersion: 1\nRequires-Dist: sample>=1\n",
             "example-1.dist-info/WHEEL": b"Wheel-Version: 1.0\nRoot-Is-Purelib: true\nTag: py3-none-any\n"}
    if unsafe:
        files[unsafe] = b"unsafe path"
    output = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(output)
    for name, raw in files.items():
        digest = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(raw).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
        writer.writerow([name, "sha256="+digest, str(len(raw))])
    writer.writerow(["example-1.dist-info/RECORD", "", ""])
    files["example-1.dist-info/RECORD"] = output.getvalue().encode()
    if tamper:
        files[tamper] = b"tampered after RECORD"
    if extra:
        files[extra] = b"unrecorded"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as archive:
        for name, raw in files.items():
            archive.writestr(name, raw)


def test_wheel_record_integrity_without_extracting_or_executing(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "example.whl"
    make_wheel(path)
    report = wheel.verify_wheel(path)
    assert report["name"] == "example" and report["version"] == "1"
    assert report["files_verified"] == 3
    assert report["requires_dist"] == ["sample>=1"]
    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == [path]
    for options in [{"tamper": "example/__init__.py"}, {"extra": "unrecorded.py"},
                    {"unsafe": "../escape.py"}, {"unsafe": "pkg/./alias.py"},
                    {"unsafe": "C:/escape.py"}, {"unsafe": "pkg\\escape.py"}]:
        make_wheel(path, **options)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            wheel.verify_wheel(path)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        wheel.verify_wheel(path)

import json

def test_durable_leases_and_consensus(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path/'queue.sqlite'
    queue = LocalCoordinator(path)
    task_id = queue.add('x+x', {'x': '1/3'})
    telemetry = AggregateTelemetry()
    first = LeaseWorker(queue, 'alice', ExactExecutor(), telemetry=telemetry).run_once()
    assert first['status'] == 'awaiting_second_worker'
    recovered = LocalCoordinator(path)
    assert recovered.submit('alice', task_id, first['result_id']) == 'awaiting_second_worker'
    second = LeaseWorker(recovered, 'bob', ExactExecutor(), telemetry=telemetry).run_once()
    assert second['status'] == 'verified'
    assert second['result_id'] == first['result_id']
    assert recovered.submit('alice', task_id, first['result_id']) == 'verified'
    assert recovered.status(task_id) == 'verified'
    snapshot = telemetry.snapshot()
    assert snapshot['counts']['verified'] == 1
    serialized = json.dumps(snapshot)
    assert 'alice' not in serialized and 'bob' not in serialized and task_id not in serialized
    assert 'x+x' not in serialized


def test_cancelled_work_never_submitted(tmp_path):
    queue = LocalCoordinator(tmp_path/'queue.sqlite')
    task_id = queue.add('1+1', {})
    class CancellingExecutor(ExactExecutor):
        def execute(self, task, **kwargs):
            queue.cancel(task_id)
            return super().execute(task, **kwargs)
    executor = CancellingExecutor()
    worker = LeaseWorker(queue, 'worker', executor)
    assert worker.run_once()['status'] == 'cancelled'
    assert queue.status(task_id) == 'cancelled'
    assert executor.completed == 0
    assert worker.telemetry.snapshot()['counts']['cancelled'] == 1


def test_quota_before_new_lease_and_idle(tmp_path):
    queue = LocalCoordinator(tmp_path/'queue.sqlite')
    executor = ExactExecutor(ExecutionBudget(max_tasks=1))
    worker = LeaseWorker(queue, 'worker', executor)
    assert worker.run_once()['status'] == 'idle'
    queue.add('1+1', {})
    assert worker.run_once()['status'] == 'awaiting_second_worker'
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match='before acquiring'):
        worker.run_once()


def test_executor_contract_budget_and_cancel_boundaries():
    executor = ExactExecutor(ExecutionBudget(max_tasks=1))
    with pytest.raises(ExecutionCancelled):
        executor.execute({'expression': '1+1', 'values': {}}, cancelled=lambda: True)
    assert executor.attempted == 0
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        executor.execute({'expression': '1+1', 'values': {}, 'code': 'shell'})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        executor.execute({'expression': 'x', 'values': {'x': True}})
    assert executor.execute({'expression': '1/3+1/3', 'values': {}})['value'] == '2/3'
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        executor.execute({'expression': '1', 'values': {}})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ExecutionBudget(max_tasks=True)


def test_post_calculation_cancellation_discards_result():
    checks = iter([False, True])
    executor = ExactExecutor()
    with pytest.raises(ExecutionCancelled):
        executor.execute({'expression': '1+1', 'values': {}}, cancelled=lambda: next(checks))
    assert executor.attempted == 1 and executor.completed == 0


def test_telemetry_rejects_unbounded_labels_and_is_detached():
    telemetry = AggregateTelemetry()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        telemetry.record('participant-alice')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        telemetry.record('failed', duration_seconds=float('nan'))
    telemetry.record('failed', duration_seconds=2)
    snapshot = telemetry.snapshot()
    snapshot['counts']['failed'] = 200
    assert telemetry.snapshot()['counts']['failed'] == 1
    assert sum(telemetry.snapshot()['duration_buckets'].values()) == 1


def test_cooperative_timeout_discards_completed_calculation(monkeypatch):
    from services.worker import executor as module
    times = iter([0, 2])
    monkeypatch.setattr(module.time, 'monotonic', lambda: next(times))
    executor = ExactExecutor(ExecutionBudget(timeout_seconds=1))
    with pytest.raises(TimeoutError):
        executor.execute({'expression': '1+1', 'values': {}})
    assert executor.attempted == 1 and executor.completed == 0


def test_arithmetic_growth_rejected_before_evaluation(monkeypatch):
    from services.worker import executor as module
    def forbidden_calculate(*args, **kwargs):
        raise AssertionError('Unbounded arithmetic reached evaluator')
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, 'calculate', forbidden_calculate)
    executor = ExactExecutor()
    for source in ('2**(2**16)', '2**1000000000', '(((x**16)**16)**16)**16'):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            executor.execute({'expression': source, 'values': {'x': 2}})
    assert executor.attempted == 0

from fractions import Fraction
import math
import pytest

from nablamath.numeric.pde_general import Poisson1D, solve_poisson_1d
from nablamath.worlds.validation_observational import Observation, compare_measurements

def test_boundary_contracts():
    assert BC('dirichlet', 2).residual(2, 7) == 0
    assert BC('neumann', -3).residual(9, -3) == 0
    assert BC('robin', 8, 2, 3).residual(1, 2) == 0
    assert BC('neumann', 0).to_data()['derivative_convention'] == 'positive_x'


@pytest.mark.parametrize('args', [('periodic', 0), ('robin', 0, 0, 0), ('dirichlet', math.nan), ('neumann', True)])
def test_invalid_boundary(args):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        BC(*args)


def test_poisson_manufactured_quadratic_nonzero_boundaries():
    # u = 3 + 2x + x(2-x), hence -u'' = 2.
    p = Poisson1D(2, BC('dirichlet', 3), BC('dirichlet', 7))
    result = solve_poisson_1d(p, lambda x: 2, cells=31)
    for x, y in zip(result['positions'], result['values']):
        assert y == pytest.approx(3+2*x+x*(2-x), abs=2e-13)
    assert result['experimental_validation'] is False


def test_poisson_sinusoidal_second_order():
    p = Poisson1D(1, BC('dirichlet', 0), BC('dirichlet', 0))
    errors = []
    for cells in (16, 32):
        result = solve_poisson_1d(p, lambda x: math.pi**2*math.sin(math.pi*x), cells=cells)
        errors.append(max(abs(y-math.sin(math.pi*x)) for x,y in zip(result['positions'],result['values'])))
    assert 3.9 < errors[0]/errors[1] < 4.1


@pytest.mark.parametrize('length', [0, -1, True, math.inf])
def test_invalid_poisson_domain(length):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Poisson1D(length, BC('dirichlet', 0), BC('dirichlet', 0))


def test_poisson_rejects_unsupported_boundaries_and_nonfinite_forcing():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Poisson1D(1, BC('neumann', 0), BC('dirichlet', 0))
    p = Poisson1D(1, BC('dirichlet', 0), BC('dirichlet', 0))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        solve_poisson_1d(p, lambda _: math.nan)
    # A single interior cell receives both endpoint contributions.
    assert solve_poisson_1d(Poisson1D(1,BC('dirichlet',2),BC('dirichlet',4)), lambda _: 0,cells=2)['values'] == (2,3,4)


def test_measurement_exact_unit_conversion_and_bias():
    observations = [Observation('a',Quantity(1,KILOMETER),Quantity(2,METER),'synthetic fixture',True),
                    Observation('b',Quantity(1000,METER),Quantity(2,METER),'synthetic fixture',True)]
    result = compare_measurements(observations,[Quantity(1001,METER),Quantity(999,METER)],tolerance=Quantity(0,METER))
    assert result['mean_signed_residual'] == '0'
    assert result['mean_absolute_residual'] == '1/1000'
    assert result['coverage_fraction'] == '1'
    assert result['evidence'] == 'synthetic_comparison'
    assert result['independent_provenance_verified'] is False


def test_measurement_mismatch_and_duplicate_rejected():
    o = Observation('a', Quantity(1,METER),Quantity(0,METER),'lab declaration')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        compare_measurements([o],[Quantity(1,SECOND)],tolerance=Quantity(0,METER))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        compare_measurements([o,o],[Quantity(1,METER)]*2,tolerance=Quantity(0,METER))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Observation('a',Quantity(1,METER),Quantity(-1,METER),'lab')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Observation('a',Quantity(1,METER),Quantity(0,METER),'')


def test_constant_acceleration_exact_point_solution():
    result = constant_acceleration(UQ.around(1000,0,METER), UQ.around(2,0,METER/SECOND),
                                   UQ.around(3,0,METER/SECOND**2), UQ.around(2,0,SECOND))
    assert result['position'].interval.lower == result['position'].interval.upper == 1010
    assert result['velocity'].interval.lower == result['velocity'].interval.upper == 8


def test_uncertain_propagation_encloses_corner_solutions():
    result = constant_acceleration(UQ.around(1,1,METER), UQ.around(0,2,METER/SECOND),
                                   UQ.around(0,3,METER/SECOND**2), UQ.around(2,1,SECOND))
    interval = result['position'].interval
    for x in (0,2):
        for v in (-2,2):
            for a in (-3,3):
                for t in (1,3):
                    value = x+v*t+Fraction(1,2)*a*t*t
                    assert interval.lower <= value <= interval.upper
    assert result['experimental_validation'] is False


def test_uncertain_rejects_negative_time_and_units():
    inputs = [UQ.around(0,0,METER),UQ.around(0,0,METER/SECOND),UQ.around(0,0,METER/SECOND**2)]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        constant_acceleration(*inputs,UQ.around(0,1,SECOND))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        constant_acceleration(*inputs,UQ.around(1,0,METER))

"""Independent answers, adversarial candidates and end-to-end reproducibility."""
from dataclasses import replace

class ScientificContractTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_canonical_polynomial_and_roundtrip(self):
        a = ScientificTask('polynomial_integral', coefficients=(1, 2, 0))
        b = ScientificTask('polynomial_integral', coefficients=(F(1), F(2)))
        self.assertEqual(a.content_id, b.content_id)
        self.assertEqual(a, ScientificTask.from_data(a.to_data()))
        self.assertEqual(PolynomialSpec((1, 2)).evaluate(3), 7)

    def test_reject_ambiguous_or_excessive_inputs(self):
        for coefficients in [(), (True,), (.5,), ('x',), (2**257,), (1,)*34]:
            with self.subTest(coefficients=str(coefficients)[:50]), self.assertRaises((ValueError, ZeroDivisionError)):
                PolynomialSpec(coefficients)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ScientificTask('linear_system', matrix=((1, 2),), rhs=(1,))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ScientificTask('other')
        row = generate('linear_system', 1).task.to_data()
        row['matrix'] = [1]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ScientificTask.from_data(row)
        row = generate('linear_system', 1).task.to_data()
        row['schema_version'] = 2
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ScientificTask.from_data(row)

    def test_generation_and_independent_solution_many_seeds(self):
        for family in ('polynomial_integral', 'linear_system'):
            for size in (1, 3, 8):
                for seed in range(10):
                    with self.subTest(family=family, size=size, seed=seed):
                        generated = generate(family, seed, size)
                        self.assertEqual(generated, generate(family, seed, size))
                        self.assertEqual(solve(generated.task), generated.witness)
                        self.assertTrue(verify(generated.task, generated.witness).valid)
                        wrong = list(generated.witness)
                        wrong[-1] += 1
                        self.assertFalse(verify(generated.task, tuple(wrong)).valid)

    def test_exact_known_linear_solution_and_singularity(self):
        task = ScientificTask('linear_system', matrix=((2, 1), (1, -1)), rhs=(5, 1))
        self.assertEqual(solve(task), (F(2), F(1)))
        self.assertTrue(verify(task, (2, 1)).valid)
        singular = ScientificTask('linear_system', matrix=((1, 1), (2, 2)), rhs=(2, 4))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            solve(singular)
        self.assertFalse(verify(singular, (1, 1)).valid)
        self.assertFalse(verify(task, (1,)).valid)

    def test_constant_of_integration_and_polynomial_identity(self):
        task = ScientificTask('polynomial_integral', coefficients=(0, 0, 3))
        self.assertEqual(solve(task), (F(0), F(0), F(0), F(1)))
        self.assertTrue(verify(task, (123, 0, 0, 1)).valid)
        # A perturbation vanishing at x=0,1 would evade a two-sample check.
        self.assertFalse(verify(task, (0, 1, -1, 1)).valid)

    def test_constructor_limits(self):
        for seed, size in [(-1, 3), (True, 3), (2**63, 3), (0, 0), (0, 9)]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                generate('linear_system', seed, size)


class ScientificDatasetTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.generated = generate('linear_system', 42)
        self.record = make_record(self.generated.task, solve(self.generated.task), license_id='MIT',
                                  provenance='synthetic unit test', seed=42)

    def test_record_reexecution_rejects_tampering(self):
        self.assertTrue(validate_record(self.record))
        for key, value in [('solution', ['0', '0', '0']), ('task_id', 'bad'), ('split', 'invalid'),
                           ('license_id', ''), ('license_id', 5), ('verification', {'valid': True}),
                           ('difficulty', {'status': 'calibrated'}),
                           ('generator', {'name': 'inverse-v1', 'seed': 43})]:
            with self.subTest(key=key):
                row = copy.deepcopy(self.record)
                row[key] = value
                self.assertFalse(validate_record(row))

    def test_variants_stay_in_one_partition(self):
        splits = {split_for_task(generate('linear_system', seed).task) for seed in range(30)}
        self.assertEqual(len(splits), 1)
        self.assertTrue(audit_contamination({'train': [self.record]})['clean'])
        audit = audit_contamination({'train': [self.record], 'test': [self.record]})
        self.assertFalse(audit['clean'])
        self.assertEqual(len(audit['overlaps']['tasks']), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(audit['overlaps']['families']), 1)

    def test_missing_rights_and_wrong_candidate_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            make_record(self.generated.task, self.generated.witness, license_id='', provenance='test', seed=42)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            make_record(self.generated.task, (F(0),)*3, license_id='MIT', provenance='test', seed=42)


class ScientificArtifactTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_svg_png_and_exact_metadata(self):
        task = generate('polynomial_integral', 3).task
        scene = task_scene(task, solve(task))
        root = ET.fromstring(render_svg(scene))
        data = json.loads(root.find('{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}metadata').text)
        self.assertEqual(data, scene.to_data())
        png = render_png(scene, 100, 100)
        self.assertEqual(png[:8], b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n')
        offset = 8
        compressed = b''
        while offset < len(png):
            length = struct.unpack('>I', png[offset:offset+4])[0]
            kind = png[offset+4:offset+8]
            payload = png[offset+8:offset+8+length]
            crc = struct.unpack('>I', png[offset+8+length:offset+12+length])[0]
            self.assertEqual(crc, zlib.crc32(kind+payload))
            if kind == b'IDAT':
                compressed += payload
            if kind == b'tEXt':
                self.assertEqual(json.loads(payload.split(b'\0',1)[1]), data)
            offset += 12+length
        self.assertEqual(len(zlib.decompress(compressed)), 100*(1+100*3))

    def test_text_is_escaped_in_all_document_backends(self):
        document = Document('<script>_%\\input{bad}', (Section('Heading', '<img src=x> #panic("bad")'),))
        html = to_html(document)
        self.assertNotIn('<script>', html)
        self.assertNotIn('<img src=x>', html)
        tex = to_latex(document)
        self.assertNotIn('\\input{bad}', tex)
        self.assertIn(r'\_', tex)
        typst = to_typst(document)
        self.assertIn('#text(', typst)
        self.assertIn('\\"bad\\"', typst)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            Figure('../outside.png', 'bad')

    def test_cycle_is_reproducible_and_rejects_corruption(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            a, b = Path(directory)/'a', Path(directory)/'b'
            summary = run_cycle(a, count=8, seed=13, license_id='MIT', provenance='synthetic test')
            self.assertEqual(summary['accepted'], 8)
            self.assertEqual(summary['formal_proofs'], 0)
            self.assertTrue(verify_bundle(a))
            run_cycle(b, count=8, seed=13, license_id='MIT', provenance='synthetic test')
            self.assertEqual((a/'manifest.json').read_bytes(), (b/'manifest.json').read_bytes())
            for path in a.rglob('*'):
                if path.is_file():
                    self.assertEqual(path.read_bytes(), (b/path.relative_to(a)).read_bytes())
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                run_cycle(a, count=1, seed=0, license_id='MIT', provenance='test')
            records = (a/'records.jsonl').read_text()
            (a/'records.jsonl').write_text(records.replace('"formal_proof":false', '"formal_proof":true'))
            self.assertFalse(verify_bundle(a))
            # Even updating the hash cannot make a falsified certificate pass.
            manifest = json.loads((a/'manifest.json').read_text())
            manifest['files']['records.jsonl'] = hashlib.sha256((a/'records.jsonl').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            (a/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
            self.assertFalse(verify_bundle(a))

    def test_failed_cycle_leaves_no_output(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            target = Path(directory)/'result'
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                run_cycle(target, count=2, seed=0, size=9, license_id='MIT', provenance='test')
            self.assertEqual(list(Path(directory).iterdir()), [])

    @unittest.skipUnless(shutil.which('pdflatex'), 'optional pdflatex absent')
    def test_pdf_compiles_with_escaped_content_and_preserves_existing_output(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            doc = Document('Synthetic report', (Section('Result', 'Exact: 2 & 3, 100% _ # $ { } ~ ^',
                           equations=(Equation(Symbol('x'), Number(F(1, 3))),)),))
            path = build_pdf(doc, Path(directory)/'result.pdf', 'latex')
            self.assertTrue(path.read_bytes().startswith(b'%PDF-'))
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                build_pdf(doc, path, 'latex')

    def test_cli_cycle_and_verification(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            target = Path(directory)/'cycle'
            self.assertEqual(main(['forge', str(target), '--count', '2', '--license', 'MIT', '--provenance', 'test']), 0)
            self.assertEqual(main(['check-bundle', str(target)]), 0)
            self.assertEqual(main(['check-bundle', str(target/'missing')]), 1)


class MultimodalAlignmentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rehashed_wrong_scene_is_rejected(self):

            self.assertFalse(verify_bundle(root))

"""Analytic references and adversarial cases for later-phase foundations."""
from dataclasses import replace

class FalsifierTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_minimal_counterexample_in_declared_integer_domain(self):
        result = search_equivalence('x*x', 'x', radius=4)
        self.assertEqual(result.status, 'counterexample')
        self.assertEqual(result.witness, (('x', -1),))
        self.assertEqual((result.left_value, result.right_value), ('1', '-1'))

    def test_domain_mismatch_and_skipped_singularities(self):
        result = search_equivalence('x/x', '1')
        self.assertEqual(result.status, 'domain_counterexample')
        self.assertEqual(result.witness, (('x', 0),))
        result = search_equivalence('x/x', '1', compare_domains=False)
        self.assertEqual(result.status, 'no_counterexample_in_finite_domain')
        self.assertEqual(result.skipped_undefined, 1)
        self.assertFalse(result.formal_proof)

    def test_budget_and_finite_domain_are_distinct(self):
        result = search_equivalence('x+y', 'y+x', budget=3)
        self.assertEqual(result.status, 'budget_exhausted')
        self.assertEqual(result.checked, 3)
        self.assertFalse(result.exhaustive)
        result = search_equivalence('x+y', 'y+x', radius=2)
        self.assertEqual(result.checked, 25)
        self.assertTrue(result.exhaustive)
        self.assertFalse(result.formal_proof)
        self.assertEqual(search_equivalence('2', '3').status, 'counterexample')

    def test_reject_cost_and_executable_input(self):
        for left in ['x**100', 'x**y', '__import__("os")', 'a+b+c+d+e', '((x**8)**8)**8**8']:
            with self.subTest(left=left), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                search_equivalence(left, '0')
        for radius, budget in [(33, 10), (3, 0), (True, 10)]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                search_equivalence('x', 'x', radius=radius, budget=budget)

    def test_cli(self):
        self.assertEqual(main(['falsify', 'x*x', 'x']), 0)


class WorldValidationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_convergence_order_against_closed_form(self):
        for name, initial in [('exponential_decay', (1,)), ('harmonic_oscillator', (1, 0))]:
            for method, bounds in [('euler', (.8, 1.2)), ('rk4', (3.8, 4.2))]:
                with self.subTest(name=name, method=method):
                    result = convergence_study(ModelSpec(name, initial), method=method)
                    self.assertGreater(result['observed_order'], bounds[0])
                    self.assertLess(result['observed_order'], bounds[1])
                    self.assertTrue(result['improves'])
                    self.assertFalse(result['experimental_validation'])

    def test_oscillator_energy_and_units(self):
        result = simulate(ModelSpec('harmonic_oscillator', (1, 0)), steps=100)
        self.assertLess(result['energy_drift_per_unit_mass'], 1e-10)
        self.assertEqual(result['state_units'], ('m', 'm/s'))
        self.assertEqual(len(result['trajectory']), 101)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result['final'][0], math.cos(1), places=8)

    def test_zero_state_roundoff_does_not_invent_an_order(self):
        result = convergence_study(ModelSpec('harmonic_oscillator', (0, 0)))
        self.assertIsNone(result['observed_order'])
        self.assertTrue(result['within_tolerance'])

    def test_invalid_models_and_budgets(self):
        for name, initial, rate, duration in [('other', (1,), 1, 1), ('exponential_decay', (), 1, 1),
                ('harmonic_oscillator', (float('nan'),0), 1,1), ('exponential_decay',(1,),0,1),
                ('exponential_decay',(1,),1,float('inf'))]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                ModelSpec(name, initial, rate, duration)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            simulate(ModelSpec('exponential_decay', (1,)), steps=100001)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            convergence_study(ModelSpec('exponential_decay', (1,)), tolerance=float('nan'))
        self.assertEqual(main(['simulate','exponential_decay','--initial','1']), 0)
        self.assertEqual(main(['simulate','exponential_decay','--initial','1','--method','euler']), 1)


class PolicyEvolutionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.calibration = (ModelSpec('exponential_decay', (1,), .75),)
        self.holdout = tuple(ModelSpec('exponential_decay', (1,), r) for r in (.5,.6,.7,.8,.9,1.))
        self.baseline, self.candidate = SolverPolicy('euler',20), SolverPolicy('rk4',20)

    def test_selection_then_heldout_paired_evaluation(self):
        chosen = select_on_calibration((self.baseline,self.candidate), self.calibration)
        self.assertEqual(chosen,self.candidate)
        result = evaluate_proposal(chosen,self.baseline,self.calibration,self.holdout)
        self.assertTrue(result['accepted'])
        self.assertEqual(result['wins'],6)
        self.assertEqual(result['sign_test_p_value'],1/64)
        self.assertEqual(result['candidate_derivative_calls'],80)
        self.assertEqual(result['rollback_policy'], {'method':'euler','steps':20})

    def test_contamination_duplicates_budget_and_regressions(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            evaluate_proposal(self.candidate,self.baseline,self.calibration,(self.calibration[0],)+self.holdout)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            evaluate_proposal(self.candidate,self.baseline,self.calibration,(self.holdout[0],)*5)
        self.assertFalse(evaluate_proposal(self.candidate,self.baseline,self.calibration,self.holdout,
                                         max_derivative_calls=30)['accepted'])
        self.assertFalse(evaluate_proposal(self.baseline,self.candidate,self.calibration,self.holdout)['accepted'])
        ties = evaluate_proposal(self.baseline,self.baseline,self.calibration,self.holdout)
        self.assertFalse(ties['accepted'])
        self.assertEqual(ties['sign_test_p_value'],1)
        self.assertEqual(ties['ties'],6)


class CircuitTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_series_and_parallel_against_hand_calculations(self):
        series = solve_dc((Resistor('a','b',10),Resistor('b','0',10)),{'a':1})
        self.assertEqual(dict(series.voltages),{'0':0,'a':20,'b':10})
        self.assertEqual(series.branch_currents,(1,1))
        self.assertEqual(series.dissipated_power,20)
        self.assertTrue(series.verified)
        parallel = solve_dc((Resistor('a','0',10),Resistor('a','0',20)),{'a':3})
        self.assertEqual(dict(parallel.voltages)['a'],20)
        self.assertEqual(parallel.branch_currents,(2,1))
        self.assertEqual(parallel.supplied_power,60)

    def test_ground_balance_and_disconnected_network(self):
        for r in (0,-1):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                Resistor('a','0',r)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            solve_dc((Resistor('a','0',10),Resistor('b','c',10)),{'a':1})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            solve_dc((Resistor('a','0',10),),{'a':1,'0':0})
        result = solve_dc((Resistor('a','0',10),),{'a':1,'0':-1})
        self.assertTrue(result.verified)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            solve_dc((Resistor('a','0',10),),{'missing':1})


class VersionedClaimsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_revision_dependencies_refutation_and_impact(self):
        ledger = ClaimLedger()
        a = ClaimRevision('A','Model A','proposed')
        aid = ledger.append(a)
        b = ClaimRevision('B','Depends on model A','supported', ('experiment:01',), (aid,))
        bid = ledger.append(b)
        refuted = ClaimRevision('A','Model A','refuted', ('counterexample:02',), previous=aid)
        rid = ledger.append(refuted)
        self.assertEqual(ledger.latest('A'),refuted)
        self.assertEqual(set(ledger.affected_by(aid)), {bid,rid})
        self.assertEqual(ledger.revisions[0],a)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory)/'claims.jsonl'
            ledger.save(path)
            self.assertEqual(ClaimLedger.load(path).revisions,ledger.revisions)
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                ledger.save(path)
            path.write_text(path.read_text().replace('Model A','Model Z'))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                ClaimLedger.load(path)

    def test_missing_evidence_stale_revision_or_dependency(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ClaimRevision('A','Statement','supported')
        ledger = ClaimLedger((ClaimRevision('A','Statement','proposed'),))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ledger.append(ClaimRevision('A','Changed','proposed'))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ledger.append(ClaimRevision('B','Statement','proposed',dependencies=('missing',)))
        self.assertEqual(len(ledger.revisions),1)

def test_reject_noncanonical_values(value):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        canonical_payload(value)
